|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[StoreOrderResponse](#schemastoreorderresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Client Error|[Error](#schemaerror)|
|401|Unauthorized|User is not authorized. Must log in first|Inline|
|404|Not Found|Not Found Error|[Error](#schemaerror)|
|409|Conflict|Invalid State Error|[Error](#schemaerror)|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Invalid Request Error|[Error](#schemaerror)|
|500|Internal Server Error|Server Error|[Error](#schemaerror)|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Cancel Order Transfer

<a id="opIdPostOrdersIdTransferCancel"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9000/store/orders/string/transfer/cancel \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'x-publishable-api-key: string' \
  -H "Cookie: connect.sid=${API_KEY}"
```

`POST /store/orders/{id}/transfer/cancel`

Cancel an order transfer that the logged-in customer previously requested using the [Request Order Transfer](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#orders_postordersidtransferrequest) API route.

<h3 id="cancel-order-transfer-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|The order's ID.|
|x-publishable-api-key|header|string|true|Publishable API Key created in the Medusa Admin.|
|x-medusa-locale|header|string|false|The locale in BCP 47 format to retrieve localized content.|
|fields|query|string|false|Comma-separated fields that should be included in the returned data.<br>if a field is prefixed with `+` it will be added to the default fields, using `-` will remove it from the default fields.<br>without prefix it will replace the entire default fields.|
|locale|query|string|false|The locale in BCP 47 format to retrieve localized content.|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[StoreOrderResponse](#schemastoreorderresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Client Error|[Error](#schemaerror)|
|401|Unauthorized|User is not authorized. Must log in first|Inline|
|404|Not Found|Not Found Error|[Error](#schemaerror)|
|409|Conflict|Invalid State Error|[Error](#schemaerror)|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Invalid Request Error|[Error](#schemaerror)|
|500|Internal Server Error|Server Error|[Error](#schemaerror)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
cookie_auth, jwt_token
</aside>

## Decline Order Transfer

<a id="opIdPostOrdersIdTransferDecline"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9000/store/orders/string/transfer/decline \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'x-publishable-api-key: string' \
  -d '{
    "token": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /store/orders/{id}/transfer/decline`

Decline an order transfer previously requested, typically by the admin user using the [Request Order Transfer Admin API route](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#orders_postordersidtransferrequest).

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "token": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="decline-order-transfer-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|The order's ID.|
|x-publishable-api-key|header|string|true|Publishable API Key created in the Medusa Admin.|
|x-medusa-locale|header|string|false|The locale in BCP 47 format to retrieve localized content.|
|fields|query|string|false|Comma-separated fields that should be included in the returned data.<br>if a field is prefixed with `+` it will be added to the default fields, using `-` will remove it from the default fields.<br>without prefix it will replace the entire default fields.|
|locale|query|string|false|The locale in BCP 47 format to retrieve localized content.|
|body|body|[StoreDeclineOrderTransfer](#schemastoredeclineordertransfer)|false|none|
|» token|body|string|true|The order transfer's token issued when the transfer was requested.|

<h3 id="decline-order-transfer-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[StoreOrderResponse](#schemastoreorderresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Client Error|[Error](#schemaerror)|
|401|Unauthorized|User is not authorized. Must log in first|Inline|
|404|Not Found|Not Found Error|[Error](#schemaerror)|
|409|Conflict|Invalid State Error|[Error](#schemaerror)|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Invalid Request Error|[Error](#schemaerror)|
|500|Internal Server Error|Server Error|[Error](#schemaerror)|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Request Order Transfer

<a id="opIdPostOrdersIdTransferRequest"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9000/store/orders/string/transfer/request \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'x-publishable-api-key: string' \
  -H "Cookie: connect.sid=${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "description": "string",
    "update_order_email": false
  }'
```

`POST /store/orders/{id}/transfer/request`

Request an order to be transfered to the logged-in customer's account. The transfer is confirmed using the [Accept Order Transfer](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#orders_postordersidtransferaccept) API route.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "description": "string",
  "update_order_email": false
}
```

<h3 id="request-order-transfer-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|The order's ID.|
|x-publishable-api-key|header|string|true|Publishable API Key created in the Medusa Admin.|
|x-medusa-locale|header|string|false|The locale in BCP 47 format to retrieve localized content.|
|fields|query|string|false|Comma-separated fields that should be included in the returned data.<br>if a field is prefixed with `+` it will be added to the default fields, using `-` will remove it from the default fields.<br>without prefix it will replace the entire default fields.|
|locale|query|string|false|The locale in BCP 47 format to retrieve localized content.|
|body|body|[StoreRequestOrderTransfer](#schemastorerequestordertransfer)|false|none|
|» description|body|string|false|The transfer's description, which can be shown to the other customer receiving the request.|
|» update_order_email|body|boolean|false|Whether to update the order's email to the receiving customer's email. By default, the order's email will not be updated.|

<h1 id="medusa-storefront-api-payment-collections">Payment Collections</h1>

A cart must have a payment collection with an authorized payment session.

Use these API routes during checkout to set the cart's payment provider and authorize its payment session.


<a href="https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/checkout/payment">How to implement payment during checkout.</a>

## Create Payment Collection

<a id="opIdPostPaymentCollections"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9000/store/payment-collections \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'x-publishable-api-key: string' \
  -d '{
    "cart_id": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /store/payment-collections`

Create a payment collection for a cart. This is used during checkout, where the payment collection holds the cart's payment sessions.

<a href="https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/checkout/payment">Storefront guide: How to implement payment during checkout.</a>

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "cart_id": "string"
}
```

|x-publishable-api-key|header|string|true|Publishable API Key created in the Medusa Admin.|
|x-medusa-locale|header|string|false|The locale in BCP 47 format to retrieve localized content.|
|fields|query|string|false|Comma-separated fields that should be included in the returned data. if a field is prefixed with `+` it will be added to the default fields, using `-` will remove it from the default fields. without prefix it will replace the entire default fields.|
|locale|query|string|false|The locale in BCP 47 format to retrieve localized content.|

## Initialize Payment Session of a Payment Collection

<a id="opIdPostPaymentCollectionsIdPaymentSessions"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9000/store/payment-collections/string/payment-sessions \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'x-publishable-api-key: string' \
  -d '{
    "provider_id": "pp_stripe_stripe",
    "data": {}
  }'
```

`POST /store/payment-collections/{id}/payment-sessions`

Initialize and add a payment session to a payment collection. This is used during checkout, where you create a payment collection for the cart, then initialize a payment session for the payment provider that the customer chooses.
It's highly recommended to have an amount greater than `0` in the payment collection, as some payment providers, such as Stripe, require a non-zero amount to create a payment session. Otherwise, an error will be thrown on the payment provider's side.
In cases where you want to create a payment session for a payment collection with an amount of `0`, you can use the Manual System Payment Provider instead of third-party payment providers. The Manual System Payment Provider is built into Medusa and allows you to create payment sessions without interacting with an external payment provider.
Make sure to configure the Manual System Payment Provider in your store's region. Learn more in the [Manage Region](https://docs.medusajs.com/user-guide/settings/regions#edit-region-details) user guide.


<a href="https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/checkout/payment">Storefront guide: How to implement payment during checkout.</a>

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "provider_id": "pp_stripe_stripe",
  "data": {}
}
```

<h3 id="initialize-payment-session-of-a-payment-collection-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|The payment collection's ID.|
|x-publishable-api-key|header|string|true|Publishable API Key created in the Medusa Admin.|
|x-medusa-locale|header|string|false|The locale in BCP 47 format to retrieve localized content.|
|fields|query|string|false|Comma-separated fields that should be included in the returned data. if a field is prefixed with `+` it will be added to the default fields, using `-` will remove it from the default fields. without prefix it will replace the entire default fields.|
|locale|query|string|false|The locale in BCP 47 format to retrieve localized content.|
|body|body|[StoreInitializePaymentSession](#schemastoreinitializepaymentsession)|false|none|
|» provider_id|body|string|true|The ID of the payment provider the customer chose.|
|» data|body|object|false|Any data necessary for the payment provider to process the payment.|

<h1 id="medusa-storefront-api-payment-providers">Payment Providers</h1>

Each region has a set of payment providers enabled.

During checkout, you retrieve the available payment providers in the customer's region to show them to the customer. Customers then choose their preferred provider to authorize their payment and place their order.

These API routes allow customers to view available payment providers in their region.


<a href="https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/checkout/payment">How to implement payment during checkout.</a>

## List Payment Providers

<a id="opIdGetPaymentProviders"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'http://localhost:9000/store/payment-providers?region_id=string' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'x-publishable-api-key: string'
```

`GET /store/payment-providers`

Retrieve a list of payment providers. You must provide the `region_id` query parameter to retrieve the payment providers enabled in that region.

<a href="https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/checkout/payment">Storefront guide: How to implement payment during checkout.</a>

<h3 id="list-payment-providers-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|x-publishable-api-key|header|string|true|Publishable API Key created in the Medusa Admin.|
|x-medusa-locale|header|string|false|The locale in BCP 47 format to retrieve localized content.|
|fields|query|string|false|Comma-separated fields that should be included in the returned data. if a field is prefixed with `+` it will be added to the default fields, using `-` will remove it from the default fields. without prefix it will replace the entire default fields.|
|offset|query|number|false|The number of items to skip when retrieving a list.|
|limit|query|number|false|Limit the number of items returned in the list.|
|order|query|string|false|The field to sort the data by. By default, the sort order is ascending. To change the order to descending, prefix the field name with `-`.|
|region_id|query|string|true|Filter by a region ID to get the payment providers enabled in that region.|
|with_deleted|query|boolean|false|Whether to include deleted records in the result.|
|locale|query|string|false|The locale in BCP 47 format to retrieve localized content.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "limit": 0,
  "offset": 0,
  "count": 0,
  "payment_providers": [
    {
      "id": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
  "message": "Discount must be set to dynamic",
  "type": "not_allowed"
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "message": "Entity with id 1 was not found",
  "type": "not_found"
}
```

> 409 Response

```json
{
  "code": "unknown_error",

  "type": "QueryRunnerAlreadyReleasedError"
```

```json
  "code": "api_error",
  "message": "An error occured while hashing password",
  "type": "database_error"
```

<h1 id="medusa-storefront-api-product-categories">Product Categories</h1>

Products can be categorized into categories.

These API routes allow customers to browse categories and their products.


<a href="https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/products/categories/list">How to list product categories in a storefront.</a>

## List Product Categories

<a id="opIdGetProductCategories"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9000/store/product-categories \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'x-publishable-api-key: string'
```

`GET /store/product-categories`

Retrieve a list of product categories. The product categories can be filtered by fields such as `id`. The product categories can also be sorted or paginated.

<a href="https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/products/categories/list">Storefront guide: How to retrieve a list of product categories.</a>

<h3 id="list-product-categories-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|x-publishable-api-key|header|string|true|Publishable API Key created in the Medusa Admin.|
|x-medusa-locale|header|string|false|The locale in BCP 47 format to retrieve localized content.|
|fields|query|string|false|Comma-separated fields that should be included in the returned data. if a field is prefixed with `+` it will be added to the default fields, using `-` will remove it from the default fields. without prefix it will replace the entire default fields.|
|offset|query|number|false|The number of items to skip when retrieving a list.|
|limit|query|number|false|Limit the number of items returned in the list.|
|order|query|string|false|The field to sort the data by. By default, the sort order is ascending. To change the order to descending, prefix the field name with `-`.|
|q|query|string|false|Search term to filter the product category's properties.|
|id|query|string \| [string]|false|none|
|description|query|string \| [string]|false|none|
|handle|query|string \| [string]|false|none|
|parent_category_id|query|string \| [string]|false|none|
|include_ancestors_tree|query|boolean|false|Whether to retrieve the category's parent. If you enable this, add to the `fields` query parameter `parent_category` to set the parent of a category in this field. You can either pass `*parent_category` to retreieve the fields of all parent categories, or select specific fields to make the response size smaller. For example, `fields=parent_category.id,parent_category.name`.|
|include_descendants_tree|query|boolean|false|Whether to retrieve a list of child categories. If you enable this, add to the `fields` query parameter `category_children` to set the child of a category in this field. You can either pass `*category_children` to retreieve the fields of all child categories, or select specific fields to make the response size smaller. For example, `fields=category_children.id,category_children.name`.|
|created_at|query|object|false|Filter by the category's creation date.|
|updated_at|query|object|false|Filter by the category's update date.|
|$and|query|[object]|false|none|
|$or|query|[object]|false|none|
|name|query|string \| [string]|false|none|
|with_deleted|query|boolean|false|Whether to include deleted records in the result.|
|locale|query|string|false|The locale in BCP 47 format to retrieve localized content.|
|external_id|query|string \| [string]|false|none|

<aside class="success">

</aside>

## Get a Product Category

<a id="opIdGetProductCategoriesId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9000/store/product-categories/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'x-publishable-api-key: string'
```

`GET /store/product-categories/{id}`

Retrieve a product category by its ID. You can expand the product category's relations or select the fields that should be returned.

<a href="https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/products/categories/retrieve">Storefront guide: How to retrieve a product category.</a>

<h3 id="get-a-product-category-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|The product category's ID.|
|x-publishable-api-key|header|string|true|Publishable API Key created in the Medusa Admin.|
|x-medusa-locale|header|string|false|The locale in BCP 47 format to retrieve localized content.|
|fields|query|string|false|Comma-separated fields that should be included in the returned data. if a field is prefixed with `+` it will be added to the default fields, using `-` will remove it from the default fields. without prefix it will replace the entire default fields.|
|include_ancestors_tree|query|boolean|false|Whether to retrieve the category's parent. If you enable this, add to the `fields` query parameter `parent_category` to set the parent of a category in this field. You can either pass `*parent_category` to retreieve the fields of all parent categories, or select specific fields to make the response size smaller. For example, `fields=parent_category.id,parent_category.name`.|
|include_descendants_tree|query|boolean|false|Whether to retrieve a list of child categories. If you enable this, add to the `fields` query parameter `category_children` to set the children of a category in this field. You can either pass `*category_children` to retreieve the fields of all child categories, or select specific fields to make the response size smaller. For example, `fields=category_children.id,category_children.name`.|
|locale|query|string|false|The locale in BCP 47 format to retrieve localized content.|

<h1 id="medusa-storefront-api-product-options">Product Options</h1>

A product option is a way to define different options for a product, such as "Size" or "Color". Product options can be created globally and used by multiple products, or they can be exclusive to a specific product.
These API routes allow customers to view product options.


<a href="https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/products/options">Use Product Options in a Storefront</a>

## List Product Options

<a id="opIdGetProductOptions"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9000/store/product-options \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'x-publishable-api-key: string'
```

`GET /store/product-options`

Retrieve a list of product options. The product options can be filtered by fields such as `id`. The product options can also be sorted or paginated.

<h3 id="list-product-options-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|x-publishable-api-key|header|string|true|Publishable API Key created in the Medusa Admin.|
|x-medusa-locale|header|string|false|The locale in BCP 47 format to retrieve localized content.|
|locale|query|string|false|The locale in BCP 47 format to retrieve localized content.|
|q|query|string|false|A search term to filter the product option's searchable fields.|
|title|query|string \| [string]|false|none|
|is_exclusive|query|boolean|false|Filter by whether the product option is exclusive to a product or global.|
|created_at|query|object|false|Filter by a product option's creation date.|
|updated_at|query|object|false|Filter by a product option's update date.|
|deleted_at|query|object|false|Filter by a product option's deletion date.|
|limit|query|number|false|Limit the number of items returned in the list.|
|offset|query|number|false|The number of items to skip when retrieving a list.|
|order|query|string|false|The field to sort the data by. By default, the sort order is ascending. To change the order to descending, prefix the field name with `-`.|
|with_deleted|query|boolean|false|The product option's with deleted.|
|fields|query|string|false|Comma-separated fields that should be included in the returned data. If a field is prefixed with `+` it will be added to the default fields, using `-` will remove it from the default fields. Without prefix it will replace the entire default fields.|
|$and|query|[object]|false|Join query parameters with an AND condition. Each object's content is the same type as the expected query parameters.|
|$or|query|[object]|false|Join query parameters with an OR condition. Each object's content is the same type as the expected query parameters.|
|id|query|string \| [string]|false|none|

<h1 id="medusa-storefront-api-products">Products</h1>

Customers browse products for their purchase.

A product has variants for different option values. The customer chooses from these variants before adding it to the cart.

These API routes allow customers to browse products.


<a href="https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/products">How to list products, get their prices, and more in a storefront.</a>

## List Products

<a id="opIdGetProducts"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9000/store/products \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'x-publishable-api-key: string'
```

`GET /store/products`

Retrieve a list of products. The products can be filtered by fields such as `id`. The products can also be sorted or paginated.

You can retrieve the content of the products translated to a specific locale either by passing the `locale` query parameter or by setting the `x-medusa-locale` header to the desired locale code in BCP 47 format. If you don't pass a locale, and your store has a default locale, the default locale will be used.

With localization, the products' content like title and description will be in the specified locale if a translation is available,  and fallback to the original content otherwise. Learn more in the [Localization](#localization) section.


<a href="https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/products/price">Storefront guide: How to retrieve a product variants' prices.</a>

<h3 id="list-products-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|x-publishable-api-key|header|string|true|Publishable API Key created in the Medusa Admin.|
|x-medusa-locale|header|string|false|The locale in BCP 47 format to retrieve localized content.|
|fields|query|string|false|Comma-separated fields that should be included in the returned data. if a field is prefixed with `+` it will be added to the default fields, using `-` will remove it from the default fields. without prefix it will replace the entire default fields.|
|offset|query|number|false|The number of items to skip when retrieving a list.|
|limit|query|number|false|Limit the number of items returned in the list.|
|order|query|string|false|The field to sort the data by. By default, the sort order is ascending. To change the order to descending, prefix the field name with `-`.|
|$and|query|[object]|false|Join query parameters with an AND condition. Each object's content is the same type as the expected query parameters.|
|$or|query|[object]|false|Join query parameters with an OR condition. Each object's content is the same type as the expected query parameters.|
|q|query|string|false|Search term to filter the product's searchable properties.|
|id|query|string \| [string]|false|none|
|title|query|string \| [string]|false|Filter by product titles.|
|handle|query|string \| [string]|false|Filter by product handles.|
|is_giftcard|query|boolean|false|Whether the product is a gift card.|
|collection_id|query|[string]|false|Filter by a collection's ID to retrieve the products in it.|
|tag_id|query|string \| [string]|false|Filter by a tag's ID to retrieve the products in it.|
|type_id|query|string \| [string]|false|Filter by a type's ID to retrieve the products in it.|
|created_at|query|object|false|Filter by the product's creation date.|
|updated_at|query|object|false|Filter by the product's update date.|
|region_id|query|string|false|The ID of the region the products are being viewed from. This is required if you're retrieving product variant prices with taxes.|
|province|query|string|false|The lower-case ISO 3166-2 province code the products are being viewed from. This is useful to narrow down the tax context when calculating product variant prices with taxes.|
|sales_channel_id|query|string \| [string]|false|none|
|category_id|query|string \| [string]|false|none|
|variants|query|object|false|Filter the products' variants.|
|country_code|query|string|false|The product's country code.|
|cart_id|query|string|false|The product's cart id.|
|locale|query|string|false|The locale in BCP 47 format to retrieve localized content.|
|external_id|query|string \| [string]|false|none|
|option_value_id|query|string \| [string]|false|none|
|option_id|query|string \| [string]|false|none|

## Get a Product

<a id="opIdGetProductsId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9000/store/products/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'x-publishable-api-key: string'
```

`GET /store/products/{id}`

Retrieve a product by its ID. You can expand the product's relations or select the fields that should be returned.

You can retrieve the content of the product translated to a specific locale either by passing the `locale` query parameter or by setting the `x-medusa-locale` header to the desired locale code in BCP 47 format. If you don't pass a locale, and your store has a default locale, the default locale will be used.

With localization, the product's content like title and description will be in the specified locale if a translation is available,  and fallback to the original content otherwise. Learn more in the [Localization](#localization) section.


<a href="https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/products/price">Storefront guide: How to retrieve a product variants' prices.</a>

<h3 id="get-a-product-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|The product's ID.|
|x-publishable-api-key|header|string|true|Publishable API Key created in the Medusa Admin.|
|x-medusa-locale|header|string|false|The locale in BCP 47 format to retrieve localized content.|
|fields|query|string|false|Comma-separated fields that should be included in the returned data. if a field is prefixed with `+` it will be added to the default fields, using `-` will remove it from the default fields. without prefix it will replace the entire default fields.|
|region_id|query|string|false|The ID of the region the product is being viewed from. This is required if you're retrieving product variant prices with taxes.|
|country_code|query|string|false|The country code the product is being viewed from. This is required if you're retrieving product variant prices with taxes.|
|province|query|string|false|The lower-case ISO 3166-2 province code the product is being viewed from. This is useful to narrow down the tax context when calculating product variant prices with taxes.|
|cart_id|query|string|false|The ID of the customer's cart. If set, the cart's region and shipping address's country code and province are used instead of the `region_id`, `country_code`, and `province` properties.|
|locale|query|string|false|The locale in BCP 47 format to retrieve localized content.|

<h1 id="medusa-storefront-api-regions">Regions</h1>

Regions are different countries or geographical regions that the commerce store serves customers in.

Customers can choose what region they're in to view prices of that region's currency.

Use these API routes to retrieve available regions in the store.


<a href="https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/regions">How to retrieve and store selected region in a storefront.</a>

## List Regions

<a id="opIdGetRegions"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9000/store/regions \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'x-publishable-api-key: string'
```

`GET /store/regions`

Retrieve a list of regions. The regions can be filtered by fields such as `id`. The regions can also be sorted or paginated.

<a href="https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/regions/list">Storefront guide: How to retrieve a list of regions.</a>

<h3 id="list-regions-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|x-publishable-api-key|header|string|true|Publishable API Key created in the Medusa Admin.|
|x-medusa-locale|header|string|false|The locale in BCP 47 format to retrieve localized content.|
|fields|query|string|false|Comma-separated fields that should be included in the returned data. if a field is prefixed with `+` it will be added to the default fields, using `-` will remove it from the default fields. without prefix it will replace the entire default fields.|
|offset|query|number|false|The number of items to skip when retrieving a list.|
|limit|query|number|false|Limit the number of items returned in the list.|
|order|query|string|false|The field to sort the data by. By default, the sort order is ascending. To change the order to descending, prefix the field name with `-`.|
|q|query|string|false|Search term to filter the region's searchable properties.|
|id|query|string \| [string]|false|none|
|name|query|string \| [string]|false|none|
|currency_code|query|string \| [string]|false|none|
|$and|query|[object]|false|Join query parameters with an AND condition. Each object's content is the same type as the expected query parameters.|
|$or|query|[object]|false|Join query parameters with an OR condition. Each object's content is the same type as the expected query parameters.|
|with_deleted|query|boolean|false|Whether to include deleted records in the result.|
|locale|query|string|false|The locale in BCP 47 format to retrieve localized content.|

## Get a Region

<a id="opIdGetRegionsId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9000/store/regions/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'x-publishable-api-key: string'
```

`GET /store/regions/{id}`

Retrieve a region by its ID. You can expand the region's relations or select the fields that should be returned.

<h3 id="get-a-region-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|The region's ID.|
|x-publishable-api-key|header|string|true|Publishable API Key created in the Medusa Admin.|
|x-medusa-locale|header|string|false|The locale in BCP 47 format to retrieve localized content.|
|fields|query|string|false|Comma-separated fields that should be included in the returned data. if a field is prefixed with `+` it will be added to the default fields, using `-` will remove it from the default fields. without prefix it will replace the entire default fields.|
|locale|query|string|false|The locale in BCP 47 format to retrieve localized content.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "region": {
    "id": "string",
    "name": "string",
    "currency_code": "usd",
    "automatic_taxes": true,
    "countries": [
      {
        "id": "string",
        "iso_2": "us",
        "iso_3": "usa",
        "num_code": 840,
        "name": "string",
        "display_name": "string"
      }
    ],
    "payment_providers": [
      {
        "id": "string",
        "is_enabled": true
      }
    ],
    "metadata": {},
    "created_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "updated_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  }
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "message": "Discount must be set to dynamic",
  "type": "not_allowed"
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "message": "Entity with id 1 was not found",
  "type": "not_found"
}
```

> 409 Response

```json
{
  "code": "unknown_error",
  "message": "The request conflicted with another request. You may retry the request with the provided Idempotency-Key.",
  "type": "QueryRunnerAlreadyReleasedError"
}
```

> 422 Response

```json
{
  "code": "invalid_request_error",
  "message": "Discount with code TEST already exists.",
  "type": "duplicate_error"
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "code": "api_error",
  "message": "An error occured while hashing password",
  "type": "database_error"
}
```

<h3 id="get-a-region-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Client Error|[Error](#schemaerror)|
|401|Unauthorized|User is not authorized. Must log in first|Inline|
|404|Not Found|Not Found Error|[Error](#schemaerror)|
|409|Conflict|Invalid State Error|[Error](#schemaerror)|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Invalid Request Error|[Error](#schemaerror)|
|500|Internal Server Error|Server Error|[Error](#schemaerror)|

<h3 id="get-a-region-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|region|[StoreRegion](#schemastoreregion)|true|none|The region's details.|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

<h1 id="medusa-storefront-api-return-reasons">Return Reasons</h1>

A return reason is a possible reason a customer wants to return an item.

Use these API routes when implementing return creation flow in your storefront to allow customers to select their return reason.


## List Return Reasons

<a id="opIdGetReturnReasons"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9000/store/return-reasons \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'x-publishable-api-key: string'
```

`GET /store/return-reasons`

Retrieve a list of return reasons. The return reasons can be sorted or paginated.

<h3 id="list-return-reasons-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|x-publishable-api-key|header|string|true|Publishable API Key created in the Medusa Admin.|
|x-medusa-locale|header|string|false|The locale in BCP 47 format to retrieve localized content.|
|fields|query|string|false|Comma-separated fields that should be included in the returned data. if a field is prefixed with `+` it will be added to the default fields, using `-` will remove it from the default fields. without prefix it will replace the entire default fields.|
|offset|query|number|false|The number of items to skip when retrieving a list.|
|limit|query|number|false|Limit the number of items returned in the list.|
|order|query|string|false|The field to sort the data by. By default, the sort order is ascending. To change the order to descending, prefix the field name with `-`.|
|with_deleted|query|boolean|false|Whether to include deleted records in the result.|
|locale|query|string|false|The locale in BCP 47 format to retrieve localized content.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "limit": 0,
  "offset": 0,
  "count": 0,
  "return_reasons": [
    {
      "id": "string",
      "value": "string",
      "label": "string",
      "description": "string",
      "metadata": {},
      "created_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "updated_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
    }
  ]
}
```

```json
  "type": "not_found"
}
```

```json
{
  "code": "unknown_error",
  "message": "The request conflicted with another request. You may retry the request with the provided Idempotency-Key.",
  "type": "QueryRunnerAlreadyReleasedError"
}
```

> 422 Response

```json
{
  "code": "invalid_request_error",
  "message": "Discount with code TEST already exists.",
  "type": "duplicate_error"
```

```json
  "code": "api_error",
```

<h1 id="medusa-storefront-api-returns">Returns</h1>

Customers can request to return items in their order. The admin user then receives and handles the return.

These API routes allows customers to create a return.


## Create Return

<a id="opIdPostReturns"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9000/store/returns \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'x-publishable-api-key: string' \
  -d '{
    "order_id": "string",
    "items": [
      {
        "id": "string",
        "quantity": 0,
        "reason_id": "string",
        "note": "string"
      }
    ],
    "return_shipping": {
      "option_id": "string",
      "price": 0
    },
    "note": "string",
    "receive_now": true,
    "location_id": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /store/returns`

Create a return for an order's items. The admin receives the return and process it from their side. This API route doesn't require customer authentication, so that guest customers can request a return for their orders. To restrict access to this API route, refer to the [Restrict Return Creation guide](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/commerce-modules/order/secure-return-creation).

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "order_id": "string",
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "string",
      "quantity": 0,
      "reason_id": "string",
      "note": "string"
    }
  ],
  "return_shipping": {
    "option_id": "string",
    "price": 0
  },
  "note": "string",
  "receive_now": true,
  "location_id": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="create-return-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|x-publishable-api-key|header|string|true|Publishable API Key created in the Medusa Admin.|
|x-medusa-locale|header|string|false|The locale in BCP 47 format to retrieve localized content.|
|locale|query|string|false|The locale in BCP 47 format to retrieve localized content.|
|body|body|[StoreCreateReturn](#schemastorecreatereturn)|false|none|
|» order_id|body|string|true|The ID of the order this return is created for.|
|» items|body|[[StoreCreateReturnItem](#schemastorecreatereturnitem)]|true|The return's items.|
|» return_shipping|body|[StoreCreateReturnShipping](#schemastorecreatereturnshipping)|true|The return's shipping details.|
|» note|body|string|false|A note with more details about the return.|
|» receive_now|body|boolean|false|Whether to mark the return as received.|
|» location_id|body|string|false|The ID of the location that items are returned to.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "return": {
    "items": [
      {
        "id": "string",
        "quantity": 0,
        "received_quantity": 0,
        "damaged_quantity": 0,
        "reason_id": "string",
        "note": "string",
        "item_id": "string",
        "return_id": "string",
        "metadata": {}
      }
    ],
    "status": "received",
    "id": "string",
    "display_id": 0,
    "created_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "order_id": "string",
    "location_id": "string",
    "canceled_at": "string",
    "exchange_id": "string",
    "claim_id": "string",
    "refund_amount": 0,
    "received_at": "string",
    "created_by": "string",
    "requested_at": "string"
  }
}
```

```json
  "message": "Discount must be set to dynamic",
  "type": "not_allowed"
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
  "type": "not_found"
}
```

```json
  "code": "unknown_error",

  "type": "QueryRunnerAlreadyReleasedError"
```

<h1 id="medusa-storefront-api-search">Search</h1>

Search the indexes that your application exposes to the storefront.

An index is only searchable through these API routes once it's allowed with the `configureStoreSearch` middleware.


## Search Indexes

<a id="opIdPostSearch"></a>

```bash
    "queries": [

                ],
```

`POST /store/search`

Search the indexes that your application exposes to the storefront. An index is only searchable through this route once it's allowed with the `configureStoreSearch` middleware, and a query for any other index is answered with a `404` error. Pass a single query, or a `queries` array to run a batch of queries in one round-trip to the search engine. For an index whose entity is `product`, Medusa also restricts the results to published products in the sales channels of the request's publishable API key.

<a href="https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/infrastructure-modules/search/store-search">Learn about the Store Search API route</a>

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "queries": [
    {
      "entity": "string",
      "fields": [
        "string"
      ],
      "filters": {
        "$and": [
          {}
        ],
        "$or": [
          {}
        ],
        "$not": {

            {}
          ],
          "$or": [
            {}

            ],

              "$or": [
                {}
              ],
              "$not": {},
              "q": "string"
            },
            "q": "string"
          },
          "q": "string"
        },
        "q": "string"
      },
      "pagination": {
        "skip": 0,
        "take": 0,
        "order": {},
        "cursor": "string"
      },
      "search_options": {
        "attributes_to_search_on": [
          "string"
        ],
        "match_strategy": "any",
        "typo_tolerance": true,
        "facets": [
          "string"
        ],
        "disjunctive_facets": true,
        "highlight": true,

          "semantic_ratio": 0
        },
        "count": "estimated"

    }
  ]
}
```

<h1 id="medusa-storefront-api-shipping-options">Shipping Options</h1>

A shipping option is a way of shipping an item to or from the customer.

During the checkout flow, the customer selects their preferred shipping option to receive their order.

These API routes allow customers to retrieve available shipping options for their context.


<a href="https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/checkout/shipping">How to implement shipping during checkout.</a>

## List Shipping Options for Cart

<a id="opIdGetShippingOptions"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'http://localhost:9000/store/shipping-options?cart_id=string' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'x-publishable-api-key: string'
```

`GET /store/shipping-options`

Retrieve a list of shipping options for a cart. The cart's ID is set in the required `cart_id` query parameter.

The shipping options also be sorted or paginated.

For a shipping option whose `price_type` is `calculated`, the returned `amount` isn't reliable, as its price is computed on the fly by the fulfillment provider. To retrieve its price, use the [Calculate Shipping Option Price API route](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#shipping-options_postshippingoptionsidcalculate).


<a href="https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/checkout/shipping">Storefront guide: How to implement shipping during checkout.</a>

<h3 id="list-shipping-options-for-cart-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|x-publishable-api-key|header|string|true|Publishable API Key created in the Medusa Admin.|
|x-medusa-locale|header|string|false|The locale in BCP 47 format to retrieve localized content.|
|fields|query|string|false|Comma-separated fields that should be included in the returned data. if a field is prefixed with `+` it will be added to the default fields, using `-` will remove it from the default fields. without prefix it will replace the entire default fields.|
|offset|query|number|false|The number of items to skip when retrieving a list.|
|limit|query|number|false|Limit the number of items returned in the list.|
|order|query|string|false|The field to sort the data by. By default, the sort order is ascending. To change the order to descending, prefix the field name with `-`.|
|cart_id|query|string|true|The ID of the cart to retrieve its shipping options.|
|$and|query|[object]|false|Join query parameters with an AND condition. Each object's content is the same type as the expected query parameters.|
|$or|query|[object]|false|Join query parameters with an OR condition. Each object's content is the same type as the expected query parameters.|
|is_return|query|boolean|false|Whether the shipping option can be used for returns.|
|locale|query|string|false|The locale in BCP 47 format to retrieve localized content.|

## Calculate Shipping Option Price

<a id="opIdPostShippingOptionsIdCalculate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:9000/store/shipping-options/string/calculate \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'x-publishable-api-key: string' \
  -d '{
    "cart_id": "string",
    "data": {}
  }'
```

`POST /store/shipping-options/{id}/calculate`

Calculate the price of a shipping option in a cart. Use this API route for shipping options whose `price_type` is `calculated`, as their price isn't stored but computed on the fly by the associated fulfillment provider against the cart.

If the fulfillment provider fails to calculate the price, this route returns an error.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "cart_id": "string",
  "data": {}
}
```

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|The shipping option's ID.|
|x-publishable-api-key|header|string|true|Publishable API Key created in the Medusa Admin.|
|x-medusa-locale|header|string|false|The locale in BCP 47 format to retrieve localized content.|
|locale|query|string|false|The locale in BCP 47 format to retrieve localized content.|
|fields|query|string|false|Comma-separated fields that should be included in the returned data. If a field is prefixed with `+` it will be added to the default fields, using `-` will remove it from the default fields. Without prefix it will replace the entire default fields.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» cart_id|body|string|true|The ID of the cart the shipping option is used in.|
|» data|body|object|false|Custom data that's useful for the fulfillment provider to calculate the price.|

`POST /store/store-credit-accounts/claim`

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[StoreStoreCreditAccountResponse](#schemastorestorecreditaccountresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Client Error|[Error](#schemaerror)|
|401|Unauthorized|User is not authorized. Must log in first|Inline|
|404|Not Found|Not Found Error|[Error](#schemaerror)|
|409|Conflict|Invalid State Error|[Error](#schemaerror)|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Invalid Request Error|[Error](#schemaerror)|
|500|Internal Server Error|Server Error|[Error](#schemaerror)|

```json
    {
      "id": "string",
```

```json
      "attribute": "customer_group_id",
      "operator": "gt",
      "values": [
        "cusgroup_123"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "id": "string",
  "type": "fixed",
  "target_type": "items",
  "allocation": "each",

  "currency_code": "usd",
  "max_quantity": 0,

  "apply_to_quantity": 0
}
```

The application method's details.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|promotion|object|false|none|none|
|target_rules|[[AdminPromotionRule](#schemaadminpromotionrule)]|false|none|The application method's target rules.|
|buy_rules|[[AdminPromotionRule](#schemaadminpromotionrule)]|false|none|The application method's buy rules.|
|id|string|true|none|The application method's ID.|
|type|string|false|none|The application method's type. If it's `fixed`, the promotion discounts a fixed amount. If it's `percentage`, the promotion discounts a percentage.|
|target_type|string|false|none|Which item does the promotion apply to. `items` mean the promotion applies to the cart's items; `shipping_methods` means the promotion applies to the cart's shipping methods; `order` means the promotion applies on the entire order.|
|allocation|string|false|none|How is the promotion amount discounted. `each` means the discounted amount is applied on each applicable item; `across` means the discounted amount is split accross the applicable items.|
|value|number|false|none|The amount to be discounted.|
|currency_code|string|false|none|The application method's currency code.|
|max_quantity|number|false|none|The max quantity allowed in the cart for the associated promotion to be applied.|
|buy_rules_min_quantity|number|false|none|The minimum quantity required for a `buyget` promotion to be applied. For example, if the promotion is a "Buy 2 shirts get 1 free", the value of this attribute is `2`.|
|apply_to_quantity|number|false|none|The quantity that results from matching the `buyget` promotion's condition. For example, if the promotion is a "Buy 2 shirts get 1 free", the value of this attribute is `1`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|fixed|
|type|percentage|
|target_type|items|
|target_type|shipping_methods|
|target_type|order|
|allocation|each|
|allocation|across|

The associations to create between a product variant and an inventory item.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

For example, if a customer orders one quantity of the variant, Medusa checks the availability of the quantity multiplied by the value set for `required_quantity`. When the customer orders the quantity, Medusa reserves the ordered quantity multiplied by the value set for `required_quantity`.|
|inventory_item_id|string|true|none|The ID of the inventory item to associate the variant with.|
|variant_id|string|true|none|The ID of the variant.|

The claim's details.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|The claim's ID.|
|order_id|string|true|none|The ID of the order associated with the claim.|
|claim_items|[[BaseClaimItem](#schemabaseclaimitem)]|true|none|The order items targetted by the claim.|
|additional_items|[[BaseClaimItem](#schemabaseclaimitem)]|true|none|The outbound or new items of the claim.|
|return|[AdminReturn](#schemaadminreturn)|true|none|The return's details.|
|return_id|string|false|none|The ID of the associated return.|
|no_notification|boolean|false|none|Whether the customer should be notified about changes in the claim.|
|refund_amount|number|false|none|The amount to be refunded.|
|display_id|number|true|none|The claim's display ID.|
|shipping_methods|[[AdminOrderShippingMethod](#schemaadminordershippingmethod)]|false|none|The claim's shipping methods.|
|transactions|[[BaseOrderTransaction](#schemabaseordertransaction)]|false|none|The claim's transactions.|
|metadata|object|false|none|The claim's metadata, used to store custom key-value pairs.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The claim's creation date.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The claim's update date.|
|order|[AdminOrder](#schemaadminorder)|true|none|The order's details.|
|type|string|true|none|The claim's type.|
|order_version|string|true|none|The version of the order when the claim is applied.|
|created_by|string|false|none|The ID of the user that created the claim.|
|canceled_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the claim was canceled.|
|deleted_at|string(date-time)|false|none|The date the claim was deleted.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|replace|
|type|refund|

The paginated list of claims.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|limit|number|true|none|The maximum number of items returned.|
|offset|number|true|none|The number of items skipped before retrieving the returned items.|
|count|number|true|none|The total number of items.|
|claims|[[AdminClaim](#schemaadminclaim)]|true|none|The list of claims.|
|estimate_count|number|false|none|The estimated count retrieved from the PostgreSQL query planner, which may be inaccurate.|

The details of the claim, as well as a preview of the order when the claim is applied.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|order_preview|[AdminOrderPreview](#schemaadminorderpreview)|true|none|A preview of an order if a change, such as exchange, return, edit, or claim is applied on it.|
|claim|[AdminClaim](#schemaadminclaim)|true|none|The claim's details.|

The details of the claim, its return, and a preview of the order when the claim is applied.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|return|[AdminReturn](#schemaadminreturn)|true|none|The return's details.|
|order_preview|[AdminOrderPreview](#schemaadminorderpreview)|true|none|A preview of an order if a change, such as exchange, return, edit, or claim is applied on it.|
|claim|[AdminClaim](#schemaadminclaim)|true|none|The claim's details.|

The details of the claim's return, with a preview of the order when the claim's return is applied.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|order_preview|[AdminOrderPreview](#schemaadminorderpreview)|true|none|A preview of an order if a change, such as exchange, return, edit, or claim is applied on it.|
|return|[AdminReturn](#schemaadminreturn)|true|none|The return's details.|

The details of a column in a view configuration.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|The column's ID.|
|name|string|true|none|The column's name. This is displayed in the view header.|
|description|string|false|none|The column's description.|
|field|string|true|none|The column's field in the entity.|
|sortable|boolean|true|none|Whether the column is sortable.|
|hideable|boolean|true|none|Whether the column is hideable.|
|default_visible|boolean|true|none|Whether the column is visible by default.|
|data_type|string|true|none|The data type of the column's value.|
|semantic_type|string|false|none|The column's semantic type. It can be `computed`, or other primitive types.|
|context|string|false|none|The column's context. It can be `display` or `generic`.|
|computed|object|false|none|A computed column's details. Only available if the column's `semantic_type` is `computed`.|
|relationship|object|false|none|The relationship details. Only available for relationship columns.|
|default_order|number|false|none|The column's sort order in the default view configuration.|
|category|string|false|none|The column's category.|
|render_mode|string|false|none|The column's render mode.|
|filter|object|false|none|The column's filter.|
|source|object|false|none|The column's source details. Only available if the column is from a source.|
|custom_label|boolean|false|none|Whether the column has a custom label.|
|label_id|string|false|none|The ID of the column's label, if it has a custom label.|
|metadata|object|false|none|The column's metadata.|

|Property|Value|
|---|---|

|data_type|number|
|data_type|boolean|
|data_type|object|

|data_type|currency|
|data_type|enum|
|category|status|
|category|metadata|
|category|identifier|
|category|timestamp|
|category|metric|
|category|relationship|


The list of draft orders with pagination fields.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|limit|number|true|none|The maximum number of items retrieved.|
|offset|number|true|none|The number of items skipped before retrieving the returned items.|
|count|number|true|none|The total count of items available.|
|draft_orders|[[AdminDraftOrder](#schemaadmindraftorder)]|true|none|The list of draft orders.|
|estimate_count|number|false|none|The estimated count retrieved from the PostgreSQL query planner, which may be inaccurate.|

The parameters for retrieving draft orders.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|fields|string|false|none|Comma-separated fields that should be included in the returned data. if a field is prefixed with `+` it will be added to the default fields, using `-` will remove it from the default fields. without prefix it will replace the entire default fields.|

The draft order preview's details.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|return_requested_total|number|true|none|The total of the requested return.|
|order_change|[AdminOrderChange](#schemaadminorderchange)|true|none|The order change's details.|
|items|[[AdminOrderLinePreview](#schemaadminorderlinepreview)]|true|none|The order's items.|
|shipping_methods|[object]|false|none|The order's shipping methods.|
|currency_code|string|true|none|The order's currency code.|
|version|number|true|none|The order's version when this preview is applied.|
|id|string|true|none|The order's ID.|
|region_id|string|true|none|The ID of the order's associated region.|
|customer_id|string|true|none|The ID of the customer that placed the order.|
|sales_channel_id|string|true|none|The ID of the sales channel that the order was placed in.|
|email|string(email)|true|none|The email of the customer that placed the order.|
|display_id|number|false|none|The order's display ID.|
|shipping_address|[AdminOrderAddress](#schemaadminorderaddress)|false|none|An order address.|
|billing_address|[AdminOrderAddress](#schemaadminorderaddress)|false|none|An order address.|
|payment_collections|[[AdminPaymentCollection](#schemaadminpaymentcollection)]|true|none|The order's payment collections.|
|payment_status|string|true|none|The order's payment status.|
|fulfillments|[[AdminOrderFulfillment](#schemaadminorderfulfillment)]|false|none|The order's fulfillments.|
|fulfillment_status|string|true|none|The order's fulfillment status.|
|transactions|[[BaseOrderTransaction](#schemabaseordertransaction)]|false|none|The order's transactions.|
|summary|[BaseOrderSummary](#schemabaseordersummary)|true|none|The order's summary details.|
|metadata|object|false|none|The order's metadata, can hold custom key-value pairs.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the order was created.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the order was updated.|
|original_item_total|number|true|none|The total of the order's items including taxes, excluding promotions.|
|original_item_subtotal|number|true|none|The total of the order's items excluding taxes, including promotions.|
|original_item_tax_total|number|true|none|The tax total of the order's items excluding promotions.|
|item_total|number|true|none|The total of the order's items including taxes and promotions.|
|item_subtotal|number|true|none|The total of the order's items excluding taxes, including promotions.|
|item_tax_total|number|true|none|The tax total of the order's items including promotions.|
|original_total|number|true|none|The order's total excluding promotions, including taxes.|
|original_subtotal|number|true|none|The order's total excluding taxes, including promotions.|
|original_tax_total|number|true|none|The order's tax total, excluding promotions.|
|total|number|true|none|The order's total including taxes and promotions.|
|subtotal|number|true|none|The order's total excluding taxes, including promotions.|
|tax_total|number|true|none|The order's tax total including promotions.|
|discount_total|number|true|none|The order's discount or promotions total.|
|discount_tax_total|number|true|none|The tax total of order's discount or promotion.|
|gift_card_total|number|true|none|The order's gift card total.|
|gift_card_tax_total|number|true|none|The tax total of the order's gift card.|
|shipping_total|number|true|none|The order's shipping total including taxes and promotions.|
|shipping_subtotal|number|true|none|The order's shipping total excluding taxes, including promotions.|
|shipping_tax_total|number|true|none|The tax total of the order's shipping.|
|original_shipping_total|number|true|none|The order's shipping total including taxes, excluding promotions.|
|original_shipping_subtotal|number|true|none|The order's shipping total excluding taxes, including promotions.|
|original_shipping_tax_total|number|true|none|The tax total of the order's shipping excluding promotions.|
|customer|[AdminCustomer](#schemaadmincustomer)|false|none|The customer's details.|
|sales_channel|[AdminSalesChannel](#schemaadminsaleschannel)|false|none|The sales channel's details.|
|status|string|true|none|The order's status.|
|region|[AdminRegion](#schemaadminregion)|false|none|The region's details.|
|credit_lines|[[OrderCreditLine](#schemaordercreditline)]|false|none|The order preview's credit lines.|
|credit_line_total|number|true|none|The draft order preview's credit line total.|

The details of an entity.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|string|true|none|The entity's name.|

|module|string|true|none|The module the entity belongs to.|
|propertyCount|number|true|none|The number of properties the entity has.|
|hasOverrides|boolean|true|none|Whether the entity has overrides.|


The exchange's details.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|order_id|string|true|none|The ID of the order the exchange is created for.|
|return_items|[[AdminReturnItem](#schemaadminreturnitem)]|true|none|The items returned (inbound) by the exchange.|
|additional_items|[[BaseExchangeItem](#schemabaseexchangeitem)]|true|none|The new items (outbound) sent by the exchange.|
|no_notification|boolean|false|none|Whether to send the customer notifications when the exchange is updated.|
|difference_due|number|false|none|The amount to be exchanged or refunded. If the amount is negative, it must be refunded. If positive, additional payment is required from the customer.|
|return|[AdminReturn](#schemaadminreturn)|false|none|The return's details.|
|return_id|string|false|none|The ID of the associated exchange.|
|id|string|true|none|The exchange's ID.|
|display_id|string|false|none|The exchange's display ID.|
|shipping_methods|[[BaseOrderShippingMethod](#schemabaseordershippingmethod)]|false|none|The shipping methods used to send the new (outbound) items.|
|transactions|[[BaseOrderTransaction](#schemabaseordertransaction)]|false|none|The exchange's transactions.|
|metadata|object|false|none|The exchange's metadata, can hold custom key-value pairs.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date that the exchange was created.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date that the exchange was updated.|
|order_version|string|false|none|The version of the order once the exchange is applied.|
|created_by|string|false|none|The ID of the user that created the exchange.|
|canceled_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the exchange was canceled.|
|deleted_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the exchange was deleted.|
|order|[BaseOrder](#schemabaseorder)|false|none|The order's details.|
|allow_backorder|boolean|false|none|Whether variants that are out-of-stock can still be added as additional or outbound items.|

|order_preview|[AdminOrderPreview](#schemaadminorderpreview)|true|none|A preview of an order if a change, such as exchange, return, edit, or claim is applied on it.|

The gift card's details.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|line_item|[AdminOrderLineItem](#schemaadminorderlineitem)|true|none|The item's details.|
|customer|[AdminCustomer](#schemaadmincustomer)|true|none|The customer's details.|
|id|string|true|none|The gift card's ID.|
|code|string|true|none|The gift card's code.|
|status|string|true|none|The gift card's status.|
|value|number|true|none|The gift card's amount.|
|currency_code|string|true|none|The gift card's currency code.|
|customer_id|string|true|none|The ID of the customer associated with the gift card.|
|reference_id|string|true|none|The gift card's reference ID.|
|note|string|true|none|The gift card's note.|
|reference|string|true|none|The gift card's reference.|
|expires_at|string|true|none|The date the gift card expires at.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the gift card was created at.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the gift card was updated at.|

|---|---|

|status|redeemed|

The notification's details.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|The notification's ID.|
|to|string|true|none|Where to send the notification to. For example, if `channel` is `email`, this can be an email number.|
|channel|string|true|none|Through which channel is the notification sent through.|
|template|string|true|none|The ID of the template in a third-party service used as the notification's shape.|
|data|object|false|none|Data payload to send with the notification.|
|trigger_type|string|false|none|What triggered this notification.|
|resource_id|string|false|none|The ID of the associated resource. For example, if the notification was triggered because an order was created, this would be the ID of the order.|
|resource_type|string|false|none|The type of the resource that triggered the notification.|
|receiver_id|string|false|none|The ID of the user or customer that's receiving this notification.|
|original_notification_id|string|false|none|The ID of the original notification, if this notification is resent.|
|external_id|string|false|none|The ID of the notification in an external or third-party system.|
|provider_id|string|true|none|The ID of the provider used to send the notification.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the notification was created.|


The order change's details.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|The order change's ID.|
|version|number|true|none|The order change's version. This will be the order's version when the change is applied.|
|change_type|string|false|none|The order change's type.|
|order_id|string|true|none|The ID of the order this change applies on.|
|return_id|string|true|none|The ID of the associated return.|
|exchange_id|string|true|none|The ID of the associated exchange.|
|claim_id|string|true|none|The ID of the associated claim.|
|order|[AdminOrder](#schemaadminorder)|true|none|The order's details.|
|return_order|[AdminReturn](#schemaadminreturn)|true|none|The return's details.|
|exchange|[AdminExchange](#schemaadminexchange)|true|none|The exchange's details.|
|claim|[AdminClaim](#schemaadminclaim)|true|none|The claim's details.|
|actions|[[AdminOrderChangeAction](#schemaadminorderchangeaction)]|true|none|The order change's actions.|
|status|string|true|none|The order change's status.|
|requested_by|string|true|none|The ID of the user that requested the change.|
|requested_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the order change was requested.|
|confirmed_by|string|true|none|The ID of the user that confirmed the order change.|
|confirmed_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the order change was confirmed.|
|declined_by|string|true|none|The ID of the user that declined the order change.|
|declined_reason|string|true|none|The reason the order change was declined.|
|metadata|object|true|none|The order change's metadata, can hold custom key-value pairs.|
|declined_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the order change was declined.|
|canceled_by|string|true|none|The ID of the user that canceled the order change.|
|canceled_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the order change was canceled.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the order change was created.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the order change was updated.|
|carry_over_promotions|boolean|false|none|Whether promotions from the original order should be carried over to the order change (specifically, exchanges).|
|created_by|string|true|none|The ID of the user that created the order change.|
|internal_note|string|true|none|The order change's internal note.|
|no_notification|boolean|false|none|Whether to send notifications to the customer regarding the order change's updates.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|change_type|return|
|change_type|exchange|
|change_type|claim|
|change_type|edit|
|status|canceled|
|status|requested|
|status|pending|
|status|confirmed|
|status|declined|

The order change action's details.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|The action's ID.|
|order_change_id|string|true|none|The ID of the order change that the action belongs to.|
|order_change|object|true|none|none|
|order_id|string|true|none|The ID of the order the associated change is for.|
|return_id|string|true|none|The ID of the associated return.|
|claim_id|string|true|none|The ID of the associated claim.|
|exchange_id|string|true|none|The ID of the associated exchange.|
|order|[AdminOrder](#schemaadminorder)|true|none|The order's details.|
|reference|string|true|none|The name of the table this action applies on.|
|reference_id|string|true|none|The ID of the record in the referenced table.|
|action|string|true|none|The applied action.|
|details|object|true|none|The action's details.|
|internal_note|string|true|none|A note that's viewed only by admin users.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the action was created.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the action was updated.|
|ordering|number|true|none|The action's order in the sequence of actions.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|reference|claim|
|reference|exchange|
|reference|return|
|reference|order_shipping_method|

The fulfillment's details.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|The fulfillment's ID.|
|location_id|string|true|none|The ID of the location the items are fulfilled from.|
|packed_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the items were packed.|
|shipped_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the items were shipped.|
|delivered_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the items were delivered.|
|canceled_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the items were canceled.|
|data|object|true|none|Data useful for the fulfillment provider handling it. This is taken from the associated shipping option.|
|provider_id|string|true|none|The ID of the fulfillment provider used to handle the fulfillment.|
|shipping_option_id|string|true|none|The ID of the associated shipping option.|
|metadata|object|true|none|The fulfillment's metadata, can hold custom key-value pairs.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the fulfillment was created.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the fulfillment was updated.|
|requires_shipping|boolean|true|none|Whether the fulfillment requires shipping.|
|created_by|string|true|none|The ID of the user that created the fulfillment.|
|marked_shipped_by|string|true|none|The ID of the user that marked the fulfillment as shipped.|

The item's details.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|The item's ID.|
|title|string|true|none|The item's title.|
|subtitle|string|true|none|The item's subtitle.|
|thumbnail|string|true|none|The URL of the item's thumbnail.|
|variant|[AdminProductVariant](#schemaadminproductvariant)|false|none|The product variant's details.|
|variant_id|string|true|none|The ID of the associated variant.|
|product|[AdminProduct](#schemaadminproduct)|false|none|The product's details.|
|product_id|string|true|none|The ID of the associated product.|
|product_title|string|true|none|The item's product title.|
|product_description|string|true|none|The item's product description.|
|product_subtitle|string|true|none|The item's product subtitle.|
|product_type|string|true|none|The item's product type.|
|product_collection|string|true|none|The ID of the collection the item's product belongs to.|
|product_handle|string|true|none|The item's product handle.|
|variant_sku|string|true|none|The item's variant SKU.|
|variant_barcode|string|true|none|The item's variant barcode.|
|variant_title|string|true|none|The item's variant title.|
|variant_option_values|object|true|none|The values of the item variant's options.|
|requires_shipping|boolean|true|none|Whether the item requires shipping.|
|is_discountable|boolean|true|none|Whether the item is discountable.|
|is_tax_inclusive|boolean|true|none|Whether the item is tax inclusive.|
|compare_at_unit_price|number|false|none|The original price of the item before a promotion or sale.|
|unit_price|number|true|none|The item's unit price.|
|quantity|number|true|none|The item's quantity.|
|tax_lines|[[BaseOrderLineItemTaxLine](#schemabaseorderlineitemtaxline)]|false|none|The item's tax lines.|
|adjustments|[[BaseOrderLineItemAdjustment](#schemabaseorderlineitemadjustment)]|false|none|The item's adjustments.|
|detail|object|true|none|none|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the item was created.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the item was updated.|
|metadata|object|true|none|The item's metadata, can hold custom key-value pairs.|
|original_total|number|true|none|The item's total including taxes, excluding promotions.|
|original_subtotal|number|true|none|The item's total excluding taxes, including promotions.|
|original_tax_total|number|true|none|The total taxes of the item, excluding promotions.|
|item_total|number|true|none|The total taxes of the item, including promotions.|
|item_subtotal|number|true|none|The item's total excluding taxes, including promotions.|
|item_tax_total|number|true|none|The total taxes of the item, including promotions.|
|total|number|true|none|The item's total, including taxes and promotions.|
|subtotal|number|true|none|The item's subtotal excluding taxes, including promotions.|
|tax_total|number|true|none|The tax total of the item including promotions.|
|discount_total|number|true|none|The total discount amount of the item.|
|discount_tax_total|number|true|none|The total taxes applied on the discounted amount.|
|refundable_total|number|true|none|The total refundable amount of the item's total.|
|refundable_total_per_unit|number|true|none|The total refundable amount of the item's total for a single quantity.|
|product_type_id|string|true|none|The ID of the associated product's type.|
