A preview of an order if a change, such as exchange, return, edit, or claim is applied on it.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|return_requested_total|number|true|none|The total of the requested return.|
|order_change|[AdminOrderChange](#schemaadminorderchange)|true|none|The order change's details.|
|items|[[AdminOrderLinePreview](#schemaadminorderlinepreview)]|true|none|The order's items.|
|shipping_methods|[object]|false|none|The order's shipping methods.|
|currency_code|string|true|none|The order's currency code.|
|version|number|true|none|The order's version when this preview is applied.|
|id|string|true|none|The order's ID.|
|region_id|string|true|none|The ID of the order's associated region.|
|customer_id|string|true|none|The ID of the customer that placed the order.|
|sales_channel_id|string|true|none|The ID of the sales channel that the order was placed in.|
|email|string(email)|true|none|The email of the customer that placed the order.|
|display_id|number|false|none|The order's display ID.|
|shipping_address|[AdminOrderAddress](#schemaadminorderaddress)|false|none|An order address.|
|billing_address|[AdminOrderAddress](#schemaadminorderaddress)|false|none|An order address.|
|payment_collections|[[AdminPaymentCollection](#schemaadminpaymentcollection)]|true|none|The order's payment collections.|
|payment_status|string|true|none|The order's payment status.|
|fulfillments|[[AdminOrderFulfillment](#schemaadminorderfulfillment)]|false|none|The order's fulfillments.|
|fulfillment_status|string|true|none|The order's fulfillment status.|
|transactions|[[BaseOrderTransaction](#schemabaseordertransaction)]|false|none|The order's transactions.|
|summary|[BaseOrderSummary](#schemabaseordersummary)|true|none|The order's summary details.|
|metadata|object|false|none|The order's metadata, can hold custom key-value pairs.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the order was created.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the order was updated.|
|original_item_total|number|true|none|The total of the order's items including taxes, excluding promotions.|
|original_item_subtotal|number|true|none|The total of the order's items excluding taxes, including promotions.|
|original_item_tax_total|number|true|none|The tax total of the order's items excluding promotions.|
|item_total|number|true|none|The total of the order's items including taxes and promotions.|
|item_subtotal|number|true|none|The total of the order's items excluding taxes, including promotions.|
|item_tax_total|number|true|none|The tax total of the order's items including promotions.|
|original_total|number|true|none|The order's total excluding promotions, including taxes.|
|original_subtotal|number|true|none|The order's total excluding taxes, including promotions.|
|original_tax_total|number|true|none|The order's tax total, excluding promotions.|
|total|number|true|none|The order's total including taxes and promotions.|
|subtotal|number|true|none|The order's total excluding taxes, including promotions.|
|tax_total|number|true|none|The order's tax total including promotions.|
|discount_total|number|true|none|The order's discount or promotions total.|
|discount_tax_total|number|true|none|The tax total of order's discount or promotion.|
|gift_card_total|number|true|none|The order's gift card total.|
|gift_card_tax_total|number|true|none|The tax total of the order's gift card.|
|shipping_total|number|true|none|The order's shipping total including taxes and promotions.|
|shipping_subtotal|number|true|none|The order's shipping total excluding taxes, including promotions.|
|shipping_tax_total|number|true|none|The tax total of the order's shipping.|
|original_shipping_total|number|true|none|The order's shipping total including taxes, excluding promotions.|
|original_shipping_subtotal|number|true|none|The order's shipping total excluding taxes, including promotions.|
|original_shipping_tax_total|number|true|none|The tax total of the order's shipping excluding promotions.|
|customer|[AdminCustomer](#schemaadmincustomer)|false|none|The customer's details.|
|sales_channel|[AdminSalesChannel](#schemaadminsaleschannel)|false|none|The sales channel's details.|
|status|string|true|none|The order's status.|
|region|[AdminRegion](#schemaadminregion)|false|none|The region's details.|
|credit_lines|[[OrderCreditLine](#schemaordercreditline)]|false|none|The order preview's credit lines.|
|credit_line_total|number|true|none|The order preview's credit line total.|
|item_discount_total|number|true|none|The total discount amount applied on the order's items.|
|shipping_discount_total|number|true|none|The total discount amount applied on the order's shipping.|
|custom_display_id|string|false|none|The custom display ID of the order.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|payment_status|canceled|
|payment_status|not_paid|
|payment_status|awaiting|
|payment_status|authorized|
|payment_status|partially_authorized|
|payment_status|captured|
|payment_status|partially_captured|
|payment_status|partially_refunded|
|payment_status|refunded|
|payment_status|requires_action|
|fulfillment_status|canceled|
|fulfillment_status|not_fulfilled|
|fulfillment_status|partially_fulfilled|
|fulfillment_status|fulfilled|
|fulfillment_status|partially_shipped|
|fulfillment_status|shipped|
|fulfillment_status|partially_delivered|
|fulfillment_status|delivered|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|The shipping method's ID.|
|order_id|string|true|none|The ID of the order the shipping method belongs to.|
|name|string|true|none|The shipping method's name.|
|description|string|false|none|The shipping method's description.|
|amount|number|true|none|The shipping method's amount.|
|is_tax_inclusive|boolean|true|none|Whether the shipping method's amount includes applied taxes.|
|shipping_option_id|string|true|none|The ID of the shipping option this method was created from.|
|data|object|true|none|The shipping method's data, useful for fulfillment provider handling its fulfillment.|
|metadata|object|true|none|The shipping method's metadata, can hold custom key-value pairs.|
|tax_lines|[[BaseOrderShippingMethodTaxLine](#schemabaseordershippingmethodtaxline)]|false|none|The shipping method's tax lines.|
|adjustments|[[BaseOrderShippingMethodAdjustment](#schemabaseordershippingmethodadjustment)]|false|none|The shipping method's adjustments.|
|original_total|number|true|none|The shipping method's total including taxes, excluding promotions.|
|original_subtotal|number|true|none|The shipping method's total excluding taxes, including promotions.|
|original_tax_total|number|true|none|The shipping method's total taxes excluding promotions.|
|total|number|true|none|The shipping method's total including taxes and promotions.|
|subtotal|number|true|none|The shipping method's total excluding taxes, including promotions.|
|tax_total|number|true|none|The shipping method's tax total including promotions.|
|discount_total|number|true|none|The total discounts applied on the shipping method.|
|discount_tax_total|number|true|none|The taxes applied on the discount amount.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the shipping method was created.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the shipping method was updated.|
|detail|[BaseOrderShippingDetail](#schemabaseordershippingdetail)|false|none|Details of changes to a shipping method.|

The details of a price list's price.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|variant_id|string|true|none|The ID of the product variant this price list is for.|
|rules|object|true|none|The price's rules.|
|id|string|true|none|The price's ID.|
|title|string|true|none|The price's title.|
|currency_code|string|true|none|The price's currency code.|
|amount|number|true|none|The price's amount.|
|raw_amount|object|true|none|The price's raw amount.|
|min_quantity|number|true|none|The minimum quantity that must be available in the cart for the price to be applied.|
|max_quantity|number|true|none|The maximum quantity allowed to be available in the cart for the price to be applied.|
|price_set_id|string|true|none|The ID of the price set this price belongs to.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the price was created.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the price was updated.|
|deleted_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the price was deleted.|

<h2 id="tocS_AdminReindexSearchIndex">AdminReindexSearchIndex</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaadminreindexsearchindex"></a>
<a id="schema_AdminReindexSearchIndex"></a>
<a id="tocSadminreindexsearchindex"></a>
<a id="tocsadminreindexsearchindex"></a>

```json
{
  "since": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "filters": {},
  "strategy": "swap"
}
```

The details of the reindexing to trigger on a search index. All properties are optional, so sending an empty request body rebuilds the entire index.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|since|string(date-time)|false|none|Rebuild only the documents that changed at or after this date, as an ISO 8601 date-time string. Like `filters`, this always rebuilds the index in place, as a version built from a subset of documents is never swapped in.|
|filters|object|false|none|Filters passed to the `seed` function of the index definition to rebuild only a subset of the index's documents. The accepted shape is defined by the index, such as `{ ids: ["prod_123"] }` if the index supports it.|
|strategy|string|false|none|How to rebuild the index. `swap` builds a new version of the index and swaps it in once it's ready, whereas `in_place` rewrites the version that's currently serving documents. This property is ignored, and the rebuild always runs in place, when `filters` or `since` is set.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|strategy|swap|
|strategy|in_place|

|name|string|true|none|The index's unique name, which is the name you pass to `query.search({ entity })` to search the index.|
|entity|string|true|none|The name of the data model that `query.graph` uses as an entry point to retrieve fields that aren't stored in the index.|
|provider|string|true|none|The identifier of the Search Module Provider backing this index, such as `pg-search`.|
|status|string|true|none|The index's lifecycle status. `pending` means the index was created but isn't filled yet, `building` means a seed or reindexing is in progress, `ready` means the index is serving documents, and `error` means the last seed or reindexing failed.|
|fields|[[AdminSearchIndexField](#schemaadminsearchindexfield)]|true|none|The leaf fields stored in the index, each with the capabilities declared on it.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|status|error|
|status|pending|
|status|building|
|status|ready|

<h2 id="tocS_AdminSearchIndexDeleteResponse">AdminSearchIndexDeleteResponse</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaadminsearchindexdeleteresponse"></a>
<a id="schema_AdminSearchIndexDeleteResponse"></a>
<a id="tocSadminsearchindexdeleteresponse"></a>
<a id="tocsadminsearchindexdeleteresponse"></a>

```json
{
  "id": "string",
  "object": "search_index",
  "deleted": true,
  "deleted_versions": 0
}
```

The details of deleting a search index. Every physical index built for it is dropped, so the next time search index migrations run, the index is built again from scratch at version 1.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|The name of the deleted search index.|
|object|string|true|none|The name of the deleted object.|
|deleted|boolean|true|none|Whether the search index was deleted successfully.|
|deleted_versions|number|true|none|The number of the index's versions that were dropped. It's `0` when the index is registered but was never migrated.|

<h2 id="tocS_AdminSearchIndexField">AdminSearchIndexField</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaadminsearchindexfield"></a>
<a id="schema_AdminSearchIndexField"></a>
<a id="tocSadminsearchindexfield"></a>
<a id="tocsadminsearchindexfield"></a>

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "type": "string",
  "searchable": true,
  "filterable": true,
  "sortable": true,
  "facetable": true
}
```

A leaf field stored in a search index, with the capabilities declared on it.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|string|true|none|The field's dotted path in the index, such as `title` or `variants.sku`.|
|type|string|true|none|The field's type in the index, such as `text`, `keyword`, `integer`, `float`, `date`, `boolean`, `geo`, `object`, or `vector`.|
|searchable|boolean|true|none|Whether the field is matched against a free-text search query.|
|filterable|boolean|true|none|Whether the field can be used in a search query's filters.|
|sortable|boolean|true|none|Whether search results can be sorted by this field.|
|facetable|boolean|true|none|Whether the field can be used to build facets of search results.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|The shipping option's ID.|
|name|string|true|none|The shipping option's name.|
|price_type|string|true|none|The shipping option's price type. If it's `flat`, the price is fixed and is set in the `prices` property. If it's `calculated`, the price is calculated on checkout by the associated fulfillment provider.|
|service_zone_id|string|true|none|The ID of the service zone this option belongs to.|
|service_zone|object|true|none|none|

The properties to update of the variant's inventory item association.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

```json

  "token": "string"
}
```

The response for the reset password token generation for a user. This response contains the generated reset password token that can be used to reset the user's password.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|token|string|true|none|The generated reset password token. Append it to the admin's<br>`/reset-password` page as a `token` query parameter to build a link the<br>user can open to set a new password.<br><br>The token is short-lived, can only be used once, and generating it<br>invalidates any reset password token previously issued for the user.|

The public information of a registered auth provider instance. This is safe
to expose to unauthenticated clients and never contains provider options or
secrets.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|The registered instance ID of the provider, used in authentication routes<br>(for example, `okta` in `POST /auth/user/okta`).|
|identifier|string|true|none|The provider's static identifier (for example, `oidc` or `emailpass`).|
|display_name|string|true|none|The name to display for the provider in a frontend application.|
|flow|string|true|none|The authentication flow the provider uses:<br><br>- `credentials`: the client submits credentials (for example, email and<br>password) directly to the authentication route.<br>- `redirect`: the client is redirected to the provider (for example, an<br>OIDC identity provider) and returns through a callback.<br><br>A frontend can use this to decide whether to render a credentials form or a<br>"Continue with ..." redirect button.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|flow|credentials|
|flow|redirect|

The tax line's item.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|The item's ID.|
|title|string|true|none|The item's title.|
|subtitle|string|false|none|The item's subtitle.|
|thumbnail|string|false|none|The item's thumbnail.|
|quantity|number|true|none|The item's quantity.|
|product|[BaseProduct](#schemabaseproduct)|false|none|The product's details.|
|product_id|string|false|none|The item's product id.|
|product_title|string|false|none|The item's product title.|
|product_description|string|false|none|The item's product description.|
|product_subtitle|string|false|none|The item's product subtitle.|
|product_type|string|false|none|The item's product type.|
|product_collection|string|false|none|The item's product collection.|
|product_handle|string|false|none|The item's product handle.|
|variant|[BaseProductVariant](#schemabaseproductvariant)|false|none|The product variant's details.|
|variant_id|string|false|none|The item's variant id.|
|variant_sku|string|false|none|The item's variant sku.|
|variant_barcode|string|false|none|The item's variant barcode.|
|variant_title|string|false|none|The item's variant title.|
|variant_option_values|object|false|none|The item's variant option values.|
|requires_shipping|boolean|true|none|The item's requires shipping.|
|is_discountable|boolean|true|none|The item's is discountable.|
|is_tax_inclusive|boolean|true|none|The item's is tax inclusive.|
|compare_at_unit_price|number|false|none|The item's compare at unit price.|
|unit_price|number|true|none|The item's unit price.|
|tax_lines|[object]|false|none|The item's tax lines.|
|adjustments|[[BaseLineItemAdjustment](#schemabaselineitemadjustment)]|false|none|The item's adjustments.|
|cart|[BaseCart](#schemabasecart)|true|none|The item's cart.|
|cart_id|string|true|none|The item's cart id.|
|metadata|object|false|none|The item's metadata.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|false|none|The item's created at.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|false|none|The item's updated at.|
|deleted_at|string(date-time)|false|none|The item's deleted at.|
|original_total|number|false|none|The line item's original total before discounts, including taxes.|
|original_subtotal|number|false|none|The line item's original subtotal before discounts, excluding taxes.|
|original_tax_total|number|false|none|The line item's original tax total before discounts.|
|item_total|number|false|none|The line item's total after discounts, including taxes.|
|item_subtotal|number|false|none|The line item's subtotal before discounts, excluding taxes.|
|item_tax_total|number|false|none|The line item's tax total after discounts.|
|total|number|false|none|The line item's total after discounts, including taxes.|
|subtotal|number|false|none|The line item's subtotal before discounts, excluding taxes.|
|tax_total|number|false|none|The line item's tax total after discounts.|
|discount_total|number|false|none|The total amount of discounts applied to the line item, including the tax portion of discounts.|
|discount_tax_total|number|false|none|The total amount of discounts applied to the line item's tax. Represents the tax portion of discounts.|


A cart's shipping method.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|The shipping method's ID.|
|cart_id|string|true|none|The ID of the cart this shipping method belongs to.|
|name|string|true|none|The shipping method's name.|
|description|string|false|none|The shipping method's description.|
|amount|number|true|none|The shipping method's amount.|
|is_tax_inclusive|boolean|true|none|Whether the shipping method's amount is tax inclusive.|
|shipping_option_id|string|false|none|The ID of the shipping option this method was created from.|
|data|object|false|none|The shipping method's data, useful for fulfillment handling by third-party services.|
|metadata|object|false|none|The shipping method's metadata, can hold custom key-value pairs.|
|tax_lines|[[BaseShippingMethodTaxLine](#schemabaseshippingmethodtaxline)]|false|none|The shipping method's tax lines.|
|adjustments|[[BaseShippingMethodAdjustment](#schemabaseshippingmethodadjustment)]|false|none|The shipping method's adjustments, such as applied promotions.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the shipping method was created.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the shipping method was updated.|
|original_total|number|false|none|The shipping method's original total before discounts, including taxes.|
|original_subtotal|number|false|none|The shipping method's original subtotal before discounts, excluding taxes.|
|original_tax_total|number|false|none|The shipping method's original tax total before discounts.|
|total|number|false|none|The shipping method's total after discounts, including taxes.|
|subtotal|number|false|none|The shipping method's subtotal before discounts, excluding taxes.|
|tax_total|number|false|none|The shipping method's tax total after discounts.|
|discount_total|number|false|none|The total amount of discounts applied to the shipping method, including the tax portion of discounts.|
|discount_tax_total|number|false|none|The total amount of discounts applied to the shipping method's tax. Represents the tax portion of discounts.|

The claim item's details.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|The claim item's ID.|
|claim_id|string|true|none|The ID of the claim this item belongs to.|
|order_id|string|true|none|The ID of the order this item belongs to.|
|item_id|string|true|none|The ID of the item in the order.|
|quantity|number|true|none|The quantity claimed.|
|reason|string|true|none|The claim's reason.|
|raw_quantity|object|true|none|The quantity claimed.|
|metadata|object|false|none|The item's metadata, can hold custom key-value pairs.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|false|none|The date the claim was created.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|false|none|The date the claim was updated.|
|item|[AdminOrderLineItem](#schemaadminorderlineitem)|false|none|The item's details.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|reason|missing_item|
|reason|wrong_item|
|reason|production_failure|
|reason|other|

The tax line's details.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|item|[BaseCartLineItem](#schemabasecartlineitem)|true|none|The tax line's item.|
|item_id|string|true|none|The ID of the line item this tax line belongs to.|
|total|number|true|none|The item's total including taxes and promotions.|
|subtotal|number|true|none|The item's total excluding taxes, including promotions.|
|id|string|true|none|The tax line's ID.|
|description|string|false|none|The tax line's description.|
|tax_rate_id|string|false|none|The ID of the applied tax rate.|
|code|string|true|none|The code that the tax rate is identified by.|
|rate|number|true|none|The charged rate.|
|provider_id|string|false|none|The ID of the tax provider used to calculate the tax line.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the tax line was created.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the tax line was updated.|

The order's details.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|payment_collections|[[BasePaymentCollection](#schemabasepaymentcollection)]|false|none|The order's payment collections.|
|fulfillments|[[BaseOrderFulfillment](#schemabaseorderfulfillment)]|false|none|The order's fulfillments.|
|shipping_address|[BaseOrderAddress](#schemabaseorderaddress)|false|none|An order address.|
|billing_address|[BaseOrderAddress](#schemabaseorderaddress)|false|none|An order address.|
|id|string|true|none|The order's ID.|
|version|number|true|none|The order's version.|
|region_id|string|true|none|The ID of the region associated with the order.|
|customer_id|string|true|none|The ID of the customer that placed the order.|
|sales_channel_id|string|true|none|The ID of the sales channel the order is placed in.|
|email|string(email)|true|none|The email of the customer that placed the order.|
|currency_code|string|true|none|The order's currency code.|
|display_id|number|false|none|The order's display ID.|
|items|[[BaseOrderLineItem](#schemabaseorderlineitem)]|true|none|The order's items.|
|shipping_methods|[[BaseOrderShippingMethod](#schemabaseordershippingmethod)]|true|none|The order's shipping methods.|
|payment_status|string|true|none|The order's payment status.|
|fulfillment_status|string|true|none|The order's fulfillment status.|
|transactions|[[BaseOrderTransaction](#schemabaseordertransaction)]|false|none|The order's transactions.|
|summary|[BaseOrderSummary](#schemabaseordersummary)|true|none|The order's summary details.|
|metadata|object|false|none|The order's metadata, can hold custom key-value pairs.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the order was created.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the order was updated.|
|original_item_total|number|true|none|The sum of all line items' original totals before discounts, including taxes.|
|original_item_subtotal|number|true|none|The sum of all line items' original subtotals before discounts, excluding taxes.|
|original_item_tax_total|number|true|none|The sum of all line items' original tax totals before discounts.|
|item_total|number|true|none|The sum of all line items' totals after discounts, including taxes.|
|item_subtotal|number|true|none|The sum of all line items' subtotals before discounts, excluding taxes.|
|item_tax_total|number|true|none|The sum of all line items' tax totals after discounts.|
|original_total|number|true|none|The order's total before discounts, including taxes. Calculated as the sum of `original_item_total` and `original_shipping_total`.|
|original_subtotal|number|true|none|The order's subtotal before discounts, excluding taxes. Calculated as the sum of `original_item_subtotal` and `original_shipping_subtotal`.|
|original_tax_total|number|true|none|The order's tax total before discounts. Calculated as the sum of `original_item_tax_total` and `original_shipping_tax_total`.|
|total|number|true|none|The order's final total after discounts and credit lines, including taxes.|
|subtotal|number|true|none|The order's subtotal before discounts, excluding taxes. Calculated as the sum of `item_subtotal` and `shipping_subtotal`.|
|tax_total|number|true|none|The order's tax total after discounts. Calculated as the sum of `item_tax_total` and `shipping_tax_total`.|
|discount_total|number|true|none|The total amount of discounts applied to the order, including the tax portion of discounts.|
|discount_tax_total|number|true|none|The total amount of discounts applied to the order's tax. Represents the tax portion of discounts.|
|gift_card_total|number|true|none|The order's gift card total.|
|gift_card_tax_total|number|true|none|The tax total of the order's gift card.|
|shipping_total|number|true|none|The sum of all shipping methods' totals after discounts, including taxes.|
|shipping_subtotal|number|true|none|The sum of all shipping methods' subtotals before discounts, excluding taxes.|
|shipping_tax_total|number|true|none|The sum of all shipping methods' tax totals after discounts.|
|original_shipping_total|number|true|none|The sum of all shipping methods' original totals before discounts, including taxes.|
|original_shipping_subtotal|number|true|none|The sum of all shipping methods' original subtotals before discounts, excluding taxes.|
|original_shipping_tax_total|number|true|none|The sum of all shipping methods' original tax totals before discounts.|
|status|string|true|none|The order's status.|
|credit_line_total|number|true|none|The total amount of credit lines applied to the order, including taxes. Subtracted from the final total.|
|item_discount_total|number|true|none|The sum of all discounts applied to line items, including the tax portion of discounts.|
|shipping_discount_total|number|true|none|The sum of all discounts applied to shipping methods, including the tax portion of discounts.|
|custom_display_id|string|false|none|The custom display ID of the order.|

The order change's details.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|The order change's ID.|
|version|number|true|none|The order change's version. This will be the order's version when the change is applied.|
|change_type|string|false|none|The order change's type.|
|order_id|string|true|none|The ID of the order this change applies on.|
|return_id|string|true|none|The ID of the associated return.|
|exchange_id|string|true|none|The ID of the associated exchange.|
|claim_id|string|true|none|The ID of the associated claim.|
|order|object|true|none|none|
|return_order|object|true|none|none|
|exchange|[OrderExchange](#schemaorderexchange)|true|none|The order change's exchange.|
|claim|[OrderClaim](#schemaorderclaim)|true|none|The order change's claim.|
|actions|[[OrderChangeAction](#schemaorderchangeaction)]|true|none|The order change's actions.|
|status|string|true|none|The order change's status.|
|requested_by|string|true|none|The ID of the user that requested the change.|
|requested_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the order change was requested.|
|confirmed_by|string|true|none|The ID of the user that confirmed the order change.|
|confirmed_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the order change was confirmed.|
|declined_by|string|true|none|The ID of the user that declined the order change.|
|declined_reason|string|true|none|The reason the order change was declined.|
|metadata|object|true|none|The order change's metadata, can hold custom key-value pairs.|
|declined_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the order change was declined.|
|canceled_by|string|true|none|The ID of the user that canceled the order change.|
|canceled_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the order change was canceled.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the order change was created.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the order change was updated.|
|carry_over_promotions|boolean|false|none|Whether promotions from the original order should be carried over to the order change (specifically, exchanges).|
|no_notification|boolean|false|none|Whether to send notifications to the customer regarding the order change's updates.|

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|change_type|return|
|change_type|exchange|
|change_type|claim|
|change_type|edit|
|status|canceled|
|status|requested|
|status|pending|
|status|confirmed|
|status|declined|

The order change's claim.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|The claim's ID.|
|order_id|string|true|none|The ID of the order associated with the claim.|
|claim_items|[[BaseClaimItem](#schemabaseclaimitem)]|true|none|The order items targetted by the claim.|
|additional_items|[[BaseClaimItem](#schemabaseclaimitem)]|true|none|The outbound or new items of the claim.|
|return|object|false|none|none|
|return_id|string|false|none|The ID of the associated return.|
|no_notification|boolean|false|none|Whether the customer should be notified about changes in the claim.|
|refund_amount|number|false|none|The amount to be refunded.|
|display_id|number|true|none|The claim's display ID.|
|shipping_methods|[[OrderShippingMethod](#schemaordershippingmethod)]|false|none|The claim's shipping methods.|
|transactions|[[OrderTransaction](#schemaordertransaction)]|false|none|The claim's transactions.|
|metadata|object|true|none|The claim's metadata, used to store custom key-value pairs.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|false|none|The claim's creation date.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|false|none|The claim's update date.|
|type|string|true|none|The claim's type.|
|order|[Order](#schemaorder)|false|none|The order change's order.|
|order_version|number|true|none|The claim's order version.|
|raw_refund_amount|string \| number|false|none|none|
|created_by|string|false|none|The ID of the user that created the claim.|
|deleted_at|string(date-time)|false|none|The date the claim was deleted.|
|canceled_at|string(date-time)|false|none|The date the claim was canceled.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|replace|
|type|refund|

The credit line's details.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|The credit line's ID.|
|order_id|string|true|none|The ID of the associated order.|
|order|object|true|none|none|
|reference|string|true|none|The table that this credit line references. For example, `payment_collection`.|
|reference_id|string|true|none|The ID of the record in the referenced table. For example, `paycol_123`.|
|metadata|object|true|none|The credit line's metadata, can hold custom key-value pairs.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the credit line was created.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the credit line was updated.|
|amount|number|true|none|The credit line's amount.|


The order change's exchange.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|order_id|string|true|none|The ID of the order the exchange is created for.|
|additional_items|[[BaseExchangeItem](#schemabaseexchangeitem)]|true|none|The new items (outbound) sent by the exchange.|
|no_notification|boolean|false|none|Whether to send the customer notifications when the exchange is updated.|
|difference_due|number|false|none|The amount to be exchanged or refunded. If the amount is negative, it must be refunded. If positive, additional payment is required from the customer.|
|return|[Return](#schemareturn)|false|none|The return's details.|
|return_id|string|false|none|The ID of the associated exchange.|
|id|string|true|none|The exchange's ID.|
|display_id|number|true|none|The exchange's display ID.|
|shipping_methods|[[OrderShippingMethod](#schemaordershippingmethod)]|false|none|The shipping methods used to send the new (outbound) items.|
|transactions|[[OrderTransaction](#schemaordertransaction)]|false|none|The exchange's transactions.|
|metadata|object|true|none|The exchange's metadata, can hold custom key-value pairs.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|false|none|The date that the exchange was created.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|false|none|The date that the exchange was updated.|
|order|[Order](#schemaorder)|false|none|The order change's order.|
|order_version|number|true|none|The version of the order when the exchange is applied.|
|raw_difference_due|string \| number|false|none|none|
|allow_backorder|boolean|false|none|Whether variants that are out of stock can be added to the exchange as outbound items.|

The return's details.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|The return's ID.|
|status|string|true|none|The return's status.|
|refund_amount|number|false|none|The amount refunded by this return.|

<h2 id="tocS_SearchHighlightOptions">SearchHighlightOptions</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemasearchhighlightoptions"></a>
<a id="schema_SearchHighlightOptions"></a>
<a id="tocSsearchhighlightoptions"></a>
<a id="tocssearchhighlightoptions"></a>

```json
{
  "fields": [
    "string"
  ],
  "pre_tag": "string",
  "post_tag": "string",
  "snippet": true
}
```

How the matched terms are highlighted in a search result's hits.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|fields|[string]|true|none|The dotted paths of the fields to highlight.|
|pre_tag|string|false|none|The tag inserted before a matched term. Defaults to `<mark>`.|
|post_tag|string|false|none|The tag inserted after a matched term. Defaults to `</mark>`.|
|snippet|boolean \| object|false|none|none|

<h2 id="tocS_SearchOptions">SearchOptions</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemasearchoptions"></a>
<a id="schema_SearchOptions"></a>
<a id="tocSsearchoptions"></a>
<a id="tocssearchoptions"></a>

```json
{
  "attributes_to_search_on": [
    "string"
  ],
  "match_strategy": "any",
  "typo_tolerance": true,
  "facets": [
    "string"
  ],
  "disjunctive_facets": true,
  "highlight": true,
  "distinct": "string",
  "min_score": 0,
  "include_score": true,
  "locales": [
    "string"
  ],
  "vector": {
    "field": "string",
    "value": [
      0
    ],
    "query": "string",
    "semantic_ratio": 0
  },
  "count": "estimated"
}
```

The options changing how a search query is matched, scored, and aggregated.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|attributes_to_search_on|[string]|false|none|The dotted paths of the fields to match the free-text query against. It defaults to every field marked `searchable` on the index.|
|match_strategy|string|false|none|How query terms combine.<br><br>- `"all"` (default): every term must appear as a complete token.<br>- `"any"`: at least one term must match.<br>- `"last"`: typeahead. Completed terms must match in full; the last term<br>  is a prefix, so `"my sear"` matches `"My search results"`.|
|typo_tolerance|boolean|false|none|Whether to match terms that are misspelled by a character or two. It's ignored unless the query includes a free-text `q` and the searched fields have typo tolerance enabled in the index's settings.|
|facets|[string \| object]|false|none|The facets to compute alongside the hits. A string is shorthand for a `value` facet on that field.|
|disjunctive_facets|boolean|false|none|Whether to compute each facet ignoring the filter on that same field, so a storefront keeps showing sibling values of an active filter.|
|highlight|boolean \| [SearchHighlightOptions](#schemasearchhighlightoptions)|false|none|none|
|distinct|string|false|none|Return at most one hit per distinct value of this field.|
|min_score|number|false|none|Discard the hits scoring below this threshold.|
|include_score|boolean|false|none|Whether to return each hit's relevance score.|
|locales|[string]|false|none|A query-time language hint, such as `["en"]`, for engines that analyze per language. A provider that can't honor it rejects the query rather than silently matching differently.|
|vector|[SearchVectorOptions](#schemasearchvectoroptions)|false|none|The options of a vector, or semantic, search.|
|count|string|false|none|How the total number of matching documents is computed. `"exact"` may be<br>rejected or slow depending on the provider.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|match_strategy|any|
|match_strategy|all|
|match_strategy|last|
|count|estimated|
|count|exact|
|count|none|

<h2 id="tocS_SearchPagination">SearchPagination</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemasearchpagination"></a>
<a id="schema_SearchPagination"></a>
<a id="tocSsearchpagination"></a>
<a id="tocssearchpagination"></a>

```json
{
  "skip": 0,
  "take": 0,
  "order": {},
  "cursor": "string"
}
```

How a search query's results are paginated and sorted.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|skip|number|false|none|The number of documents to skip before the returned hits. It's mutually exclusive with `cursor`.|
|take|number|false|none|The maximum number of hits to return.|
|order|object|false|none|The fields to sort the hits by, keyed by each field's dotted path. The reserved `_score` key sorts by relevance.|
|cursor|string|false|none|An opaque provider cursor, as returned in a previous result's `metadata.next_cursor`. It's mutually exclusive with `skip`.|

<h2 id="tocS_SearchResultMetadata">SearchResultMetadata</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemasearchresultmetadata"></a>
<a id="schema_SearchResultMetadata"></a>
<a id="tocSsearchresultmetadata"></a>
<a id="tocssearchresultmetadata"></a>

```json
{
  "skip": 0,
  "take": 0,
  "count": 0,
  "next_cursor": "string",
  "query": "string",
  "processing_time_ms": 0
}
```

The pagination and timing details of a search result.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|skip|number|true|none|The number of documents skipped before the returned hits.|
|take|number|true|none|The maximum number of hits returned.|
|count|number|true|none|The total number of matching documents. Most providers only estimate it, and it's `null` when the query sets its `count` strategy to `none`.|
|next_cursor|string|false|none|The cursor to pass in the next query's pagination to retrieve the next page, on providers that paginate with cursors.|
|query|string|false|none|The free-text query that the result was computed for.|
|processing_time_ms|number|false|none|How long the search engine took to run the query, in milliseconds.|

<h2 id="tocS_SearchVectorOptions">SearchVectorOptions</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemasearchvectoroptions"></a>
<a id="schema_SearchVectorOptions"></a>
<a id="tocSsearchvectoroptions"></a>
<a id="tocssearchvectoroptions"></a>

```json
{
  "field": "string",
  "value": [
    0
  ],
  "query": "string",
  "semantic_ratio": 0
}
```

The options of a vector, or semantic, search.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|field|string|false|none|The dotted path of the `vector` field to search in. It's optional when the index declares exactly one vector field.|
|value|[number]|false|none|A pre-computed embedding to search with. It's mutually exclusive with `query`.|
|query|string|false|none|The text that the search engine embeds at query time. It requires the vector field to enable `embed`, and it's mutually exclusive with `value`.|
|semantic_ratio|number|false|none|How much the semantic score contributes relative to the keyword score, where `0` is keyword-only and `1` is semantic-only. It defaults to `1` when there's no free-text query, and `0.5` when both run together.|

The cart's details.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|The cart's ID.|
|region|[StoreRegion](#schemastoreregion)|false|none|The region's details.|
|region_id|string|false|none|The ID of the region the cart belongs to.|
|customer_id|string|false|none|The ID of the customer the cart belongs to.|
|sales_channel_id|string|false|none|The ID of the cart's sales channel. The created order is associated with the same sales channel.<br><br>A product's availability in a sales channel only filters the products you retrieve. Medusa doesn't reject a variant added to the cart when its product isn't available in the cart's sales channel. Refer to the guide in the external documentation to learn how to enforce that validation.<br>|
|email|string(email)|false|none|The email of the customer the cart belongs to.|
|currency_code|string|true|none|The cart's currency code.|
|shipping_address|[StoreCartAddress](#schemastorecartaddress)|false|none|The address's details.|
|billing_address|[StoreCartAddress](#schemastorecartaddress)|false|none|The address's details.|
|items|[[StoreCartLineItem](#schemastorecartlineitem)]|false|none|The cart's items.|
|shipping_methods|[[StoreCartShippingMethod](#schemastorecartshippingmethod)]|false|none|The cart's shipping methods.|
|payment_collection|[StorePaymentCollection](#schemastorepaymentcollection)|false|none|The payment collection's details.|
|metadata|object|false|none|The cart's metadata, can hold custom key-value pairs.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|false|none|The date the cart was created.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|false|none|The date the cart was updated.|
|original_item_total|number|true|none|The sum of all line items' original totals before discounts, including taxes.|
|original_item_subtotal|number|true|none|The sum of all line items' original subtotals before discounts, excluding taxes.|
|original_item_tax_total|number|true|none|The sum of all line items' original tax totals before discounts.|
|item_total|number|true|none|The sum of all line items' totals after discounts, including taxes.|
|item_subtotal|number|true|none|The sum of all line items' subtotals before discounts, excluding taxes.|
|item_tax_total|number|true|none|The sum of all line items' tax totals after discounts.|
|original_total|number|true|none|The cart's total before discounts, including taxes. Calculated as the sum of `original_item_total` and `original_shipping_total`.|
|original_subtotal|number|true|none|The cart's subtotal before discounts, excluding taxes. Calculated as the sum of `original_item_subtotal` and `original_shipping_subtotal`.|
|original_tax_total|number|true|none|The cart's tax total before discounts. Calculated as the sum of `original_item_tax_total` and `original_shipping_tax_total`.|
|total|number|true|none|The cart's final total after discounts and credit lines, including taxes.|
|subtotal|number|true|none|The cart's subtotal before discounts, excluding taxes. Calculated as the sum of `item_subtotal` and `shipping_subtotal`.|
|tax_total|number|true|none|The cart's tax total after discounts. Calculated as the sum of `item_tax_total` and `shipping_tax_total`.|
|discount_total|number|true|none|The total amount of discounts applied to the cart, including the tax portion of discounts.|
|discount_tax_total|number|true|none|The total amount of discounts applied to the cart's tax. Represents the tax portion of discounts.|
|gift_card_total|number|true|none|The total gift card amount applied on the cart.|
|gift_card_tax_total|number|true|none|The total taxes applied on the gift card amount.|
|shipping_total|number|true|none|The sum of all shipping methods' totals after discounts, including taxes.|
|shipping_subtotal|number|true|none|The sum of all shipping methods' subtotals before discounts, excluding taxes.|
|shipping_tax_total|number|true|none|The sum of all shipping methods' tax totals after discounts.|
|original_shipping_total|number|true|none|The sum of all shipping methods' original totals before discounts, including taxes.|
|original_shipping_subtotal|number|true|none|The sum of all shipping methods' original subtotals before discounts, excluding taxes.|
|original_shipping_tax_total|number|true|none|The sum of all shipping methods' original tax totals before discounts.|
|promotions|[[StoreCartPromotion](#schemastorecartpromotion)]|true|none|The cart's promotions.|
|completed_at|string(date-time)|false|none|The date the cart was completed.|

The item's details.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|The item's ID.|
|title|string|true|none|The item's title.|
|subtitle|string|false|none|The item's subtitle.|
|thumbnail|string|false|none|The item's thumbnail URL.|
|quantity|number|true|none|The item's quantity.|
|product|[StoreProduct](#schemastoreproduct)|false|none|The product's details.|
|product_id|string|false|none|The ID of the associated product.|
|product_title|string|false|none|The item's product title.|
|product_description|string|false|none|The item's product description.|
|product_subtitle|string|false|none|The item's product subtitle.|
|product_type|string|false|none|The ID of the associated product's type.|
|product_collection|string|false|none|The ID of the associated product's collection.|
|product_handle|string|false|none|The item's product handle.|
|variant|[StoreProductVariant](#schemastoreproductvariant)|false|none|The variant's details.|
|variant_id|string|false|none|The ID of the associated product variant.|
|variant_sku|string|false|none|The item's variant SKU.|
|variant_barcode|string|false|none|The item's variant barcode.|
|variant_title|string|false|none|The item's variant title.|
|variant_option_values|object|false|none|The associated variant's value for the product's options.|
|requires_shipping|boolean|true|none|Whether the item requires shipping.|
|is_discountable|boolean|true|none|Whether the item is discountable.|
|is_tax_inclusive|boolean|true|none|Whether the item's price includes taxes.|
|compare_at_unit_price|number|false|none|The original price of the item before a promotion or sale.|
|unit_price|number|true|none|The price of a single quantity of the item.|
|tax_lines|[object]|false|none|The item's tax lines.|
|adjustments|[object]|false|none|The item's adjustments.|
|cart|object|true|none|none|
|cart_id|string|true|none|The ID of the cart that the line item belongs to.|
|metadata|object|false|none|The item's metadata, can hold custom key-value pairs.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|false|none|The date the item was created.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|false|none|The date the item was updated.|
|deleted_at|string(date-time)|false|none|The date the item was deleted.|
|original_total|number|false|none|The line item's original total before discounts, including taxes. This field is only available if you expand the `items.*` relation. Learn more in the [Cart Totals](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/cart/totals#retrieve-and-show-cart-item-totals) guide.|
|original_subtotal|number|false|none|The line item's original subtotal before discounts, excluding taxes. This field is only available if you expand the `items.*` relation. Learn more in the [Cart Totals](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/cart/totals#retrieve-and-show-cart-item-totals) guide.|
|original_tax_total|number|false|none|The line item's original tax total before discounts. This field is only available if you expand the `items.*` relation. Learn more in the [Cart Totals](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/cart/totals#retrieve-and-show-cart-item-totals) guide.|
|item_total|number|false|none|The line item's total after discounts, including taxes. This field is only available if you expand the `items.*` relation. Learn more in the [Cart Totals](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/cart/totals#retrieve-and-show-cart-item-totals) guide.|
|item_subtotal|number|false|none|The line item's subtotal before discounts, excluding taxes. This field is only available if you expand the `items.*` relation. Learn more in the [Cart Totals](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/cart/totals#retrieve-and-show-cart-item-totals) guide.|
|item_tax_total|number|false|none|The line item's tax total after discounts. This field is only available if you expand the `items.*` relation. Learn more in the [Cart Totals](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/cart/totals#retrieve-and-show-cart-item-totals) guide.|
|total|number|false|none|The line item's total after discounts, including taxes. This field is only available if you expand the `items.*` relation. Learn more in the [Cart Totals](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/cart/totals#retrieve-and-show-cart-item-totals) guide.|
|subtotal|number|false|none|The line item's subtotal before discounts, excluding taxes. This field is only available if you expand the `items.*` relation. Learn more in the [Cart Totals](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/cart/totals#retrieve-and-show-cart-item-totals) guide.|
|tax_total|number|false|none|The line item's tax total after discounts. This field is only available if you expand the `items.*` relation. Learn more in the [Cart Totals](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/cart/totals#retrieve-and-show-cart-item-totals) guide.|
|discount_total|number|false|none|The total amount of discounts applied to the line item, including the tax portion of discounts. This field is only available if you expand the `items.*` relation. Learn more in the [Cart Totals](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/cart/totals#retrieve-and-show-cart-item-totals) guide.|
|discount_tax_total|number|false|none|The total amount of discounts applied to the line item's tax. Represents the tax portion of discounts. This field is only available if you expand the `items.*` relation. Learn more in the [Cart Totals](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/cart/totals#retrieve-and-show-cart-item-totals) guide.|

A cart's shipping method.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|The shipping method's ID.|
|cart_id|string|true|none|The ID of the cart this shipping method belongs to.|
|name|string|true|none|The shipping method's name.|
|description|string|false|none|The shipping method's description.|
|amount|number|true|none|The shipping method's amount.|
|is_tax_inclusive|boolean|true|none|Whether the shipping method's amount is tax inclusive.|
|shipping_option_id|string|false|none|The ID of the shipping option this method was created from.|
|data|object|false|none|The shipping method's data, useful for fulfillment handling by third-party services.|
|metadata|object|false|none|The shipping method's metadata, can hold custom key-value pairs.|
|tax_lines|[object]|false|none|The shipping method's tax lines.|
|adjustments|[object]|false|none|The shipping method's adjustments, such as applied promotions.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the shipping method was created.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the shipping method was updated.|
|original_total|number|false|none|The shipping method's original total before discounts, including taxes. This field is only available if you expand the `shipping_methods.*` relation. Learn more in the [Cart Totals](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/cart/totals#retrieve-and-show-shipping-method-totals) guide.|
|original_subtotal|number|false|none|The shipping method's original subtotal before discounts, excluding taxes. This field is only available if you expand the `shipping_methods.*` relation. Learn more in the [Cart Totals](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/cart/totals#retrieve-and-show-shipping-method-totals) guide.|
|original_tax_total|number|false|none|The shipping method's original tax total before discounts. This field is only available if you expand the `shipping_methods.*` relation. Learn more in the [Cart Totals](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/cart/totals#retrieve-and-show-shipping-method-totals) guide.|
|total|number|false|none|The shipping method's total after discounts, including taxes. This field is only available if you expand the `shipping_methods.*` relation. Learn more in the [Cart Totals](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/cart/totals#retrieve-and-show-shipping-method-totals) guide.|
|subtotal|number|false|none|The shipping method's subtotal before discounts, excluding taxes. This field is only available if you expand the `shipping_methods.*` relation. Learn more in the [Cart Totals](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/cart/totals#retrieve-and-show-shipping-method-totals) guide.|
|tax_total|number|false|none|The shipping method's tax total after discounts. This field is only available if you expand the `shipping_methods.*` relation. Learn more in the [Cart Totals](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/cart/totals#retrieve-and-show-shipping-method-totals) guide.|
|discount_total|number|false|none|The total amount of discounts applied to the shipping method, including the tax portion of discounts. This field is only available if you expand the `shipping_methods.*` relation. Learn more in the [Cart Totals](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/cart/totals#retrieve-and-show-shipping-method-totals) guide.|
|discount_tax_total|number|false|none|The total amount of discounts applied to the shipping method's tax. Represents the tax portion of discounts. This field is only available if you expand the `shipping_methods.*` relation. Learn more in the [Cart Totals](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/storefront-development/cart/totals#retrieve-and-show-shipping-method-totals) guide.|

The shipping option's details.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|The shipping option's ID.|
|name|string|true|none|The shipping option's name.|
|price_type|string|true|none|The shipping option's price type. If it's `flat`, the price is fixed and is set in the `prices` property. If it's `calculated`, the price is calculated on checkout by the associated fulfillment provider.|
|service_zone_id|string|true|none|The ID of the service zone the shipping option belongs to.|
|provider_id|string|true|none|The ID of the fulfillment provider handling this option.|
|provider|object|true|none|The fulfillment provider's details.|
|type|object|true|none|The shipping option type's details.|
|shipping_profile_id|string|true|none|The ID of the associated shipping profile.|
|amount|number|true|none|The shipping option's amount for the cart. For a shipping option whose `price_type` is `calculated`, this amount is computed on the fly by the fulfillment provider against the cart.|
|data|object|true|none|The shipping option's data, useful for the provider handling fulfillment.|
|prices|[[StorePrice](#schemastoreprice)]|true|none|The shipping option's prices.|
|calculated_price|[StoreCalculatedPrice](#schemastorecalculatedprice)|true|none|The shipping option's calculated price.|
|insufficient_inventory|boolean|true|none|Whether the shipping option's location doesn't have sufficient quantity for any of the cart's items.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|price_type|flat|
|price_type|calculated|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|region_id|string|false|none|The ID of the cart's region. This affects the prices and currency of the cart.|
|shipping_address|[StoreCartAddress](#schemastorecartaddress)|false|none|The address's details.|
|billing_address|[StoreCartAddress](#schemastorecartaddress)|false|none|The address's details.|
|email|string(email)|false|none|The email of the cart's customer.|
|currency_code|string|false|none|The cart's currency code. If not provided, the region's currency is used. This affects prices in the cart, as well.|
|items|[[StoreCartLineItem](#schemastorecartlineitem)]|false|none|The cart's items.|
|sales_channel_id|string|false|none|The ID of the sales channel that cart is created in. If not provided, the store's default sales channel is associated with the cart instead.<br><br>A product's availability in a sales channel only filters the products you retrieve. Medusa doesn't reject a variant added to the cart when its product isn't available in the cart's sales channel. Refer to the guide in the external documentation to learn how to enforce that validation.<br>|
|metadata|object|false|none|The cart's metadata, can hold custom key-value pairs.|


The gift card's details.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|customer|[StoreCustomer](#schemastorecustomer)|true|none|The customer's details.|
|line_item|[StoreOrderLineItem](#schemastoreorderlineitem)|true|none|The item's details.|
|id|string|true|none|The gift card's ID.|
|code|string|true|none|The gift card's code.|
|status|string|true|none|The gift card's status.|
|value|number|true|none|The gift card's amount.|
|currency_code|string|true|none|The gift card's currency code.|
|customer_id|string|true|none|The ID of the customer that the gift card belongs to.|
|reference_id|string|true|none|The gift card's reference ID.|
|note|string|true|none|A note with more information about the gift card.|
|reference|string|true|none|The gift card's reference.|
|expires_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the gift card expires.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the gift card was created.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the gift card was updated.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|status|pending|
|status|redeemed|

The order's details.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|The order's ID.|
|region_id|string|true|none|The ID of the associated region.|
|customer_id|string|true|none|The ID of the customer that placed the order.|
|sales_channel_id|string|true|none|The ID of the sales channel the order was placed in.|
|email|string(email)|true|none|The email of the customer that placed the order.|
|currency_code|string|true|none|The order's currency code.|
|display_id|number|false|none|The order's display ID.|
|shipping_address|[StoreOrderAddress](#schemastoreorderaddress)|false|none|An order address|
|billing_address|[StoreOrderAddress](#schemastoreorderaddress)|false|none|An order address|
|items|[[StoreOrderLineItem](#schemastoreorderlineitem)]|true|none|The order's items.|
|shipping_methods|[[StoreOrderShippingMethod](#schemastoreordershippingmethod)]|true|none|The order's shipping methods.|
|payment_collections|[[StorePaymentCollection](#schemastorepaymentcollection)]|false|none|The order's payment collections.|
|payment_status|string|true|none|The order's payment status.|
|fulfillments|[[StoreOrderFulfillment](#schemastoreorderfulfillment)]|false|none|The order's fulfillments.|
|fulfillment_status|string|true|none|The order's fulfillment status.|
|summary|[BaseOrderSummary](#schemabaseordersummary)|true|none|The order's summary details.|
|metadata|object|false|none|The order's metadata, can hold custom key-value pairs.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the order was created.|
|updated_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date the order was updated.|
|original_item_total|number|true|none|The sum of all line items' original totals before discounts, including taxes.|
|original_item_subtotal|number|true|none|The sum of all line items' original subtotals before discounts, excluding taxes.|
|original_item_tax_total|number|true|none|The sum of all line items' original tax totals before discounts.|
|item_total|number|true|none|The sum of all line items' totals after discounts, including taxes.|
|item_subtotal|number|true|none|The sum of all line items' subtotals before discounts, excluding taxes.|
|item_tax_total|number|true|none|The sum of all line items' tax totals after discounts.|
|original_total|number|true|none|The order's total before discounts, including taxes. Calculated as the sum of `original_item_total` and `original_shipping_total`.|
|original_subtotal|number|true|none|The order's subtotal before discounts, excluding taxes. Calculated as the sum of `original_item_subtotal` and `original_shipping_subtotal`.|
|original_tax_total|number|true|none|The order's tax total before discounts. Calculated as the sum of `original_item_tax_total` and `original_shipping_tax_total`.|
|total|number|true|none|The order's final total after discounts and credit lines, including taxes.|
|subtotal|number|true|none|The order's subtotal before discounts, excluding taxes. Calculated as the sum of `item_subtotal` and `shipping_subtotal`.|
|tax_total|number|true|none|The order's tax total after discounts. Calculated as the sum of `item_tax_total` and `shipping_tax_total`.|
|discount_total|number|true|none|The total amount of discounts applied to the order, including the tax portion of discounts.|
|discount_tax_total|number|true|none|The total amount of discounts applied to the order's tax. Represents the tax portion of discounts.|
|gift_card_total|number|true|none|The order's gift card total.|
|gift_card_tax_total|number|true|none|The total taxes applied on the gift card's amount.|
|shipping_total|number|true|none|The sum of all shipping methods' totals after discounts, including taxes.|
|shipping_subtotal|number|true|none|The sum of all shipping methods' subtotals before discounts, excluding taxes.|
|shipping_tax_total|number|true|none|The sum of all shipping methods' tax totals after discounts.|
|original_shipping_total|number|true|none|The sum of all shipping methods' original totals before discounts, including taxes.|
|original_shipping_subtotal|number|true|none|The sum of all shipping methods' original subtotals before discounts, excluding taxes.|
|original_shipping_tax_total|number|true|none|The sum of all shipping methods' original tax totals before discounts.|
|customer|[StoreCustomer](#schemastorecustomer)|false|none|The customer's details.|
|transactions|[[BaseOrderTransaction](#schemabaseordertransaction)]|false|none|The order's transactions.|
|status|string|true|none|The order's status.|
|credit_line_total|number|true|none|The total amount of credit lines applied to the order, including taxes. Subtracted from the final total.|
|item_discount_total|number|true|none|The sum of all discounts applied to line items, including the tax portion of discounts.|
|shipping_discount_total|number|true|none|The sum of all discounts applied to shipping methods, including the tax portion of discounts.|
|custom_display_id|string|false|none|The custom display ID of the order.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|

|payment_status|canceled|

The paginated list of product categories.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|limit|number|true|none|The maximum number of items returned.|
|offset|number|true|none|The number of items skipped before retrieving the returned items.|
|count|number|true|none|The total number of items.|
|product_categories|[[StoreProductCategory](#schemastoreproductcategory)]|true|none|The list of product categories.|
|estimate_count|number|false|none|The estimated count retrieved from the PostgreSQL query planner, which may be inaccurate.|

<a id="tocSupdateaddress"></a>
<a id="tocsupdateaddress"></a>

```json
{
  "id": "string",
  "customer_id": "string",
  "company": "string",
  "first_name": "string",
  "last_name": "string",
  "address_1": "string",
  "address_2": "string",
  "city": "string",
  "country_code": "usd",
  "province": "us-ca",
  "postal_code": "string",
  "phone": "string",
  "metadata": {}
}
```

The details to update in the address.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|The ID of an existing address to update.|
|customer_id|string|false|none|The ID of the customer that this address belongs to.|
|company|string|false|none|The address's company.|
|first_name|string|false|none|The address's first name.|
|last_name|string|false|none|The address's last name.|
|address_1|string|false|none|The address's first line.|
|address_2|string|false|none|The address's second line.|
|city|string|false|none|The address's city.|
|country_code|string|false|none|The address's country code.|
|province|string|false|none|The address's ISO 3166-2 province code. Must be lower-case.|
|postal_code|string|false|none|The address's postal code.|
|phone|string|false|none|The address's phone.|
|metadata|object|false|none|The address's metadata, can hold custom key-value pairs.|

```json
    "address_1": "string",
    "address_2": "string",
    "city": "string",
    "country_code": "us",

    "phone": "string",
    "metadata": {}
  },
  "metadata": {}
}
```

The details to update in a cart.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|region_id|string|false|none|The ID of the associated region. This can affect the prices and currency code of the cart.|
|customer_id|string|false|none|The ID of the customer that the cart belongs to.|
|sales_channel_id|string|false|none|The ID of the associated sales channel.<br><br>A product's availability in a sales channel only filters the products you retrieve. Medusa doesn't reject a variant added to the cart when its product isn't available in the cart's sales channel. Refer to the guide in the external documentation to learn how to enforce that validation.<br>|
|email|string(email)|false|none|The email of the customer that the cart belongs to.|
|currency_code|string|false|none|The cart's currency code.|
|shipping_address_id|string|false|none|The ID of the cart's shipping address.|
|billing_address_id|string|false|none|The ID of the cart's billing address.|
|billing_address|[CreateAddress](#schemacreateaddress) \| [UpdateAddress](#schemaupdateaddress)|false|none|none|
|shipping_address|[CreateAddress](#schemacreateaddress) \| [UpdateAddress](#schemaupdateaddress)|false|none|none|
|metadata|object|false|none|The cart's metadata, ca hold custom key-value pairs.|

|errors|[object]|true|none|The context's errors.|

<h2 id="tocS_WorkflowExecutionDefinition">WorkflowExecutionDefinition</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaworkflowexecutiondefinition"></a>
<a id="schema_WorkflowExecutionDefinition"></a>
<a id="tocSworkflowexecutiondefinition"></a>
<a id="tocsworkflowexecutiondefinition"></a>

```json
{
  "async": true,
  "compensateAsync": true,
  "noCompensation": true,
  "continueOnPermanentFailure": true,
  "skipOnPermanentFailure": "string",
  "maxRetries": 0,
  "noWait": false,
  "retryInterval": 0,
  "retryIntervalAwaiting": 0,
  "saveResponse": true,
  "timeout": 0,
  "autoRetry": true,
  "maxAwaitingRetries": 0
}
```

The step's definition details.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|async|boolean|false|none|Whether the step is async.|
|compensateAsync|boolean|false|none|Whether the compensation function of the step is async.|
|noCompensation|boolean|false|none|Whether the step doesn't have a compensation function.|
|continueOnPermanentFailure|boolean|false|none|Whether the workflow should continue executing even if its status is changed to failed.|
|skipOnPermanentFailure|string \| boolean|false|none|none|
|maxRetries|number|false|none|The maximum number of times to retry the step.|
|noWait|boolean|false|none|Whether the workflow shouldn't wait for the step to finish before moving to the next step.|
|retryInterval|number|false|none|The interval in seconds between retry attempts when the step fails.|
|retryIntervalAwaiting|number|false|none|The interval in seconds to retry a step even if its status is `waiting_response`.|
|saveResponse|boolean|false|none|Whether the step's response is stored.|
|timeout|number|false|none|The maximum time in seconds to wait for this step to complete. If the step exceeds this time, the step's state is changed to `timeout`, but the step continues executing.|
|autoRetry|boolean|false|none|Whether the step should be automatically retried if it fails.|
|maxAwaitingRetries|number|false|none|The maximum number of times to retry the step while it's in the `waiting_response` state.|

<h2 id="tocS_WorkflowExecutionFn">WorkflowExecutionFn</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaworkflowexecutionfn"></a>
<a id="schema_WorkflowExecutionFn"></a>

<a id="tocsworkflowexecutionfn"></a>

```json
{
  "state": "failed",
  "status": "idle"
}
```

The state of the step's invokation function.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|state|string|true|none|The invokation step's state.|
|status|string|true|none|The invokation step's state.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|state|failed|
|state|not_started|
|state|invoking|
|state|compensating|
|state|done|
|state|reverted|
|state|dormant|
|state|skipped|
|state|skipped_failure|
|state|timeout|
|status|idle|
|status|ok|
|status|waiting_response|
|status|temp_failure|
|status|permanent_failure|
